english: The Kaska forests lie in the homeland of an Athabaskan-speaking people of northern British Columbia and southeastern Yukon. Kaska communities followed seasonal foods and game, travelling by rivers such as the Liard and Frances as well as established forest trails.
simp_chinese: 卡斯卡森林位于不列颠哥伦比亚北部与育空东南部使用阿萨巴斯卡语言的卡斯卡人故土。社群追随季节性食物和猎物，利用利亚德河、弗朗西斯河及既有林间小径往来。

english: Kaskankaham belongs to the Illinois country around Cahokia. The wider region once contained the largest urban settlement of the Mississippian culture, where around 1100 a city of earthen monuments covered roughly six square miles.
simp_chinese: 卡斯坎卡汉属于卡霍基亚周边的伊利诺伊地区。更广阔的区域曾拥有密西西比文化最大的城市聚落，约1100年时，一座遍布土筑纪念建筑的城市占地约六平方英里。

english:
The Kaskaskia were one of the related peoples of the Illinois Confederation, whose communities occupied a wide country around the Illinois and Mississippi rivers. In 1673 Jacques Marquette and Louis Jolliet encountered them at the Grand Village of the Illinois while returning from their voyage down the Mississippi. Their name derives from a Miami–Illinois word for a katydid.

A French mission and permanent settlement established at Kaskaskia in 1703 brought missionaries, traders and Indigenous families together. Farming, nearby lead workings and river commerce sustained the community. Marriages between French men and Illinois women were common, and their descendants helped carry the fur trade farther along the Missouri. This mingling of families and trading networks made Kaskaskia an important meeting place within the French Illinois Country.
simp_chinese:
卡斯卡斯基亚人是伊利诺伊联盟中彼此相关的族群之一，其聚落分布在伊利诺伊河与密西西比河周边的广大地区。1673年，雅克·马凯特与路易·若利耶结束密西西比河考察、踏上归途时，在伊利诺伊大村遇到他们。“卡斯卡斯基亚”源于迈阿密—伊利诺伊语中一种螽斯的名称。

1703年，法国人在卡斯卡斯基亚建立传教站和永久聚落，传教士、商人及原住民家庭在此相聚。农业、附近的铅矿和河运贸易支撑着社区。法国男子与伊利诺伊女子通婚颇为常见，他们的后代又将毛皮贸易带向密苏里河更远的地方。家庭与贸易网络的交汇，使卡斯卡斯基亚成为法国伊利诺伊地区的重要会合之地。

english: Kaskinampo belongs to the broader Tennessee country. This inland region of southeastern North America is conventionally divided into East, Middle and West Tennessee.
simp_chinese: 卡斯基南波属于广阔的田纳西地域。这片北美东南部的内陆地区通常划分为东田纳西、中田纳西和西田纳西。

english: Kaslinsky lies among lakes on the eastern slope of the Middle Urals. The modern settlement, now Kasli, was founded around a foundry in 1747. Its ironworks later became renowned for decorative castings, including an elaborate metal pavilion shown at the international exhibition of 1900.
simp_chinese: 卡斯林斯基位于中乌拉尔东坡的湖群之间。现代聚落今称卡斯利，于1747年围绕铸造厂建立。其铁厂后来以装饰铸铁闻名，包括1900年国际博览会上展出的精巧金属展亭。

english: Kasriskari belongs to Kartli, the Georgian heartland traversed by the Mtkvari, or Kura River. Known to classical writers as Iberia, this region helped consolidate Georgian political and cultural life; after Georgia's fifteenth-century partition, Kartli became a separate kingdom centred on Tbilisi.
simp_chinese: 卡斯里斯卡里属于格鲁吉亚腹地卡尔特利，姆特克瓦里河、即库拉河穿流其间。古典作者称此地为伊比利亚，这片地区促进了格鲁吉亚政治与文化的凝聚；十五世纪格鲁吉亚分裂后，卡尔特利成为以第比利斯为中心的独立王国。

english: Kassai follows the great Kasai drainage country of central Africa. The wider river rises in central Angola, turns north along the Congolese border and eventually reaches the Congo at Kwamouth. Its lower stretch is also called the Kwa, while rainforest covers much of its basin.
simp_chinese: 卡赛沿中非广大的开赛水系地区展开。更广阔的河流发源于安哥拉中部，沿刚果边界转向北方，最终在夸茅斯注入刚果河。下游也称夸河，流域大部覆盖热带雨林。

english: On the Gash River beneath the Taka Mountains, Kassala occupies a fertile pocket of eastern Sudan. Its markets and fruit gardens distinguish it from the surrounding dry country, and many of its inhabitants belong to the Hadendawa branch of the Beja. The city itself is a comparatively late foundation: the Egyptian army established a garrison here in 1834, after the conquest of Sudan. In the later nineteenth century this military outpost became a contested frontier stronghold. Its Egyptian garrison endured a long Mahdist siege before surrendering in 1886, and the town subsequently passed through Italian and Anglo-Egyptian hands.
simp_chinese: 卡萨拉坐落在苏丹东部的加什河畔，背倚塔卡山，所在之地是一片较为肥沃的土地。集市与果园使它有别于周围的干旱地区，居民中许多人属于贝贾人的哈登达瓦支系。城市本身建立较晚：埃及军队征服苏丹后，于1834年在这里设立驻军城镇。到了十九世纪后期，这座军事据点成为各方争夺的边疆要塞。埃及驻军在马赫迪军队的长期围困后于1886年投降，此后城镇又先后落入意大利与英埃势力之手。

english: Kassali belongs to the wider Lomami river country of the Congo basin. The Lomami rises near the Congo–Zambezi divide and runs north, west of and roughly parallel to the upper Congo, before joining the great river at Isangi. Its long course links southern highlands with the central basin.
simp_chinese: 卡萨利属于刚果盆地较广的洛马米河地域。洛马米河发源于刚果—赞比西分水岭附近，位于刚果河上游以西并大致与其平行北流，最终在伊桑吉汇入大河。漫长河道将南部高地与盆地中部相连。

english: Kassandreia lies in the centre of the Kassandra peninsula in Chalkidiki. Formerly called Valta, it took its modern name from nearby ancient Cassandrea in 1955.
simp_chinese: 卡桑德里亚位于哈尔基季基卡桑德拉半岛中部。它旧称瓦尔塔，1955年改用邻近古城卡桑德里亚之名。

english: Kassanje Malemba belongs to the Ambundu country of north-central Angola. The wider Kimbundu-speaking region extends east from Luanda through Bengo and Malanje. The title Ngola, borne by rulers of the principal Ambundu kingdom, gave Angola its name.
simp_chinese: 卡桑杰马伦巴属于安哥拉中北部安本杜地区。广义金本杜语地区由罗安达向东经过本戈与马兰热。安本杜主要王国统治者使用恩戈拉称号，安哥拉国名即由此而来。

english: Kassel stands at a crossing of the Fulda River in northern Hesse. First recorded in 913 as a fortified place, it had documented town rights by 1189.
simp_chinese: 卡塞尔位于黑森北部富尔达河的一处渡河地。九一三年文献已将其记为设防地点，一一八九年的文书则证实它已拥有城市权。

english: Kassengue lies in the eastern Lunda world of central Africa. Across this wider commonwealth, local states were connected to a paramount ruler bearing the title Mwane-a-Yamvu; traditions place the emergence of that title in the seventeenth century, though early chronology remains uncertain.
simp_chinese: 卡森圭位于中非的东隆达地区。在范围更大的隆达共同体中，地方国家同拥有姆瓦塔·亚姆沃称号的最高统治者相联系；传统将这一称号的出现置于17世纪，但早期年代仍有不确定性。

english: Beneath Jebel ech Chambi, the highest mountain in Tunisia, Kasserine occupies the site of Roman Cillium. The settlement gained municipal standing under the early emperors and became a colony under the Severans; its surviving theatre, baths, basilica and funerary monuments preserve the outlines of a prosperous provincial town. The late second-century tomb of Titus Flavius Secundus carries a remarkable Latin poem of 110 lines commemorating its owner. Two Roman mausoleums are also remembered in the later Arabic name al-Qasrin, meaning the two palaces. Cillium remained a bishopric in late antiquity, and in 544 its surroundings witnessed a Berber victory over Byzantine forces.
simp_chinese: 卡塞林位于突尼斯最高峰尚比山脚下，其城址承继了罗马时代的西利乌姆。聚落在早期皇帝统治下取得自治市地位，又于塞维鲁王朝时期升为殖民城市；留存的剧场、浴场、教堂和陵墓，勾勒出昔日繁荣行省城镇的面貌。当地地主提图斯·弗拉维乌斯·塞昆杜斯的陵墓建于公元2世纪末，墓上刻有长达110行的拉丁文纪念诗。两座罗马陵墓还留在后来阿拉伯语地名“卡塞林”之中，其含义为“两座宫殿”。古典时代晚期，西利乌姆仍设有主教座；544年，附近又见证了柏柏尔人击败拜占庭军队的一战。

english: Kassinga lies in the Huíla region of southern Angola, on the old road linking Jamba with Huambo. The town's better documented development belongs to a period much later than the early modern kingdoms: an exploratory party of the Dorsland Trek passed through in 1874, and twentieth-century iron mining brought warehouses, offices and accommodation to the site. Ore exports through the coast began in 1967. After Angolan independence the abandoned mining settlement became a base for Namibian liberation forces and a transit camp for exiles. A South African airborne attack in 1978 made Kassinga a deeply contested place of remembrance, with the civilian and military character of the camp remaining central to accounts of the battle.
simp_chinese: 卡辛加位于安哥拉南部的威拉地区，坐落在连接詹巴与万博的旧道路旁。这座城镇较有记载的发展远晚于近代早期诸王国的时代：多尔斯兰迁徙的一支探路队于1874年经过此地，二十世纪的铁矿开采随后带来了仓库、办公楼与工人住处。矿石自1967年起经海岸出口。安哥拉独立后，废弃矿业聚落成为纳米比亚解放武装的基地和流亡者中转营。1978年南非军队的空降袭击，使卡辛加成为记忆充满争议的地点；营地兼具的平民与军事性质，始终是有关这场战斗叙述的核心。

english: Kassongo belongs to the Mashi country of the Cuando basin. The wider river descends from the Angolan plateau through a maze of channels and wetlands, continuing as the Linyanti and Chobe before meeting the Zambezi.
simp_chinese: 卡松戈属于宽多流域的马希地区。整个区域的宽多河从安哥拉高原流下，穿过交错河道与湿地，随后以林扬蒂河、乔贝河之名继续流向赞比西河。

english: Kastamonu stands in northern Anatolia within the old Paphlagonian country. Competing explanations connect its name with ancient settlements or the Komnenian world, but its medieval reputation is more clearly recorded by Ibn Battuta. The traveller stayed forty days and praised plentiful goods and low prices. Later religious life included the Sufi master Shaban Veli, who died in 1569. The town's remembered identity therefore joins uncertain etymologies to firmer accounts of hospitality, commerce and spiritual authority in the uplands behind the Black Sea coast.
simp_chinese: 卡斯塔莫努位于安纳托利亚北部古帕夫拉戈尼亚地区。地名有联系古代聚落或科穆宁世界的不同解释，中世纪声望却更清楚地见于伊本·白图泰记述。他停留四十日，赞扬货物充足、价格低廉。后来宗教生活包括卒于1569年的苏菲导师沙班·韦利。因此，城镇身份将不确定词源，同更可靠的款待、贸易与宗教权威记载结合，属于黑海海岸后方的高地世界。

english: Kastelholm rises beside an inlet in Åland, on a site originally protected by water and moats. Built in the later fourteenth century, the Swedish castle combined defence with the administration of an island district astride the Baltic routes. Its keep, residential buildings and successive gate towers grew as noble families and royal officers contested possession. In 1571 John III imprisoned his deposed brother Eric XIV here, turning a regional stronghold into a royal prison. Artillery inflicted serious damage during the struggle against Sigismund in 1599. The surrounding woods also had a quieter royal use: hunting grounds reserved for the king and the castle's governor.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特尔霍尔姆城堡矗立在奥兰群岛的一处海湾旁，原址受到水面与护城河保护。这座瑞典城堡建于十四世纪后期，兼具防御与治理岛区的职能，其所在地区横处波罗的海航路之间。贵族家族和王室官员争夺控制权之际，主塔、居住建筑及先后修建的门塔不断扩充。1571年，约翰三世将被废黜的兄长埃里克十四世囚禁于此，使地区堡垒成为王室监狱。1599年反对西吉斯蒙德的战争中，炮火又对城堡造成严重破坏。周边林地也有较为宁静的王室用途，作为国王与城堡总督专用的猎场。

english: Kastoria occupies a promontory in Lake Orestiada, surrounded by limestone mountains. Its name is associated with beavers once found along the lake. Byzantine churches and walls preserve the town's medieval standing. Basil II took it from Bulgaria in 1018; in the early fourteenth century it passed between regional lords, the Byzantine emperor and briefly Serbian control. Ottoman conquest followed around 1385. The lakeside site and its religious buildings outlasted these political changes, while fur-working later added another connection between the town's name and livelihood.
simp_chinese: 卡斯托里亚占据奥雷斯蒂亚达湖中岬地，周围为石灰岩山。名称与湖边曾有的河狸相联。拜占庭教堂和城墙保存中世纪地位。巴西尔二世于1018年从保加利亚夺取；十四世纪初又在地方领主、拜占庭皇帝及短暂塞尔维亚控制间转手，约1385年遭奥斯曼征服。湖畔位置和宗教建筑延续于政治更替之外，后来毛皮业又在地名与生计之间增添联系。

english: Kastornoye in the Kursk country was first recorded in 1590. Two railway lines later crossed here, making the settlement a junction.
simp_chinese: 卡斯托尔诺耶位于库尔斯克地区，于1590年首次见于记载。后来两条铁路在此交会，使聚落成为交通枢纽。

english: Kastsyukovichy stands in the eastern reaches of the Belarusian lands, near the frontier with Russia. Its first recorded mention dates to 1508. The settlement belonged to the Polish realm before the First Partition of Poland transferred it to the Russian Empire in 1772. In the nineteenth century it served as the centre of a volost in Klimovichi district, within Mogilev Governorate; by mid-century it had about 1,700 inhabitants. Its later urban character developed gradually: formal town status came only in 1938. A Jewish cemetery and surviving nineteenth-century buildings preserve traces of the community that grew here after the partition.
simp_chinese: 卡斯秋科维奇位于白罗斯地区东部，靠近俄罗斯边境。它首次见于记载是在1508年。这处聚落原属波兰治下，1772年第一次瓜分波兰后划归俄罗斯帝国。十九世纪，它是莫吉廖夫省克利莫维奇县下辖一乡的中心，至该世纪中叶约有一千七百名居民。当地的城市形态是逐步形成的，直到1938年才正式获得城镇地位。犹太人墓地与留存的十九世纪建筑，仍保存着瓜分波兰后当地社会发展的痕迹。

english: Kasukuak belongs to the broader Kodiak island country off southern Alaska. Kodiak’s mountains, forests and sheltered ice-free bays supported the Sugpiaq people, who lived by fishing, hunting marine mammals and gathering.
simp_chinese: 卡苏夸克属于阿拉斯加南部外海更广阔的科迪亚克岛地区。山地、森林与避风的不冻海湾滋养着苏格皮亚克人，他们依靠捕鱼、猎取海洋哺乳动物和采集为生。

english: Kasumne belongs to the Miwok country of California. The wider Miwok homeland includes the Sacramento Valley, Sierra Nevada foothills and San Francisco Bay region, with communities traditionally living in small bands without centralized political authority.
simp_chinese: 卡苏姆尼属于加利福尼亚的米沃克地区。更广阔的米沃克家园包括萨克拉门托谷、内华达山脉麓地与旧金山湾地区，社群传统上以没有中央政治权威的小群体生活。

english: Kasungu stands on the central Malawian uplands at roughly 1,342 metres, west of the lake country. Its year is divided between summer rains, usually beginning in November or December, and a dry season extending from May to October. Sandy, nutrient-poor soils and the availability of water constrain cultivation; in the modern era the surrounding district became particularly associated with tobacco. Chichewa is the town's principal language. The district also figures in Malawi's later political history, for Hastings Banda, the country's first president, grew up on a farm nearby.
simp_chinese: 卡松古位于马拉维中部高地，海拔约1,342米，在湖区以西。一年中的夏季雨水通常从十一月或十二月开始，五月至十月则为旱季。沙质而贫瘠的土壤，加上供水条件，限制了当地耕作；到了近现代，周边地区尤其以烟草种植著称。齐切瓦语是城镇的主要语言。这里也与马拉维后来的政治史相连：该国首任总统黑斯廷斯·班达在附近一座农场长大。

english: South of Lahore, Kasur developed as a cluster of fortified settlements overlooking the alluvial country of the Beas and Sutlej. Traditions connected its foundation with Kusha, son of Rama, but the historically recorded town dates to 1525, when Kheshgi Pashtuns arriving from Kabul established themselves here. Under the Mughals its forts and family quarters formed a thriving centre of commerce. The Sufi poet Bulleh Shah made his home in Kasur, where his shrine became an enduring landmark. Mughal decline brought Durrani and Sikh struggles for control, and Ranjit Singh took the town in 1807.
simp_chinese: 卡苏尔位于拉合尔以南，由一群俯瞰比亚斯河与萨特莱杰河冲积地带的设防聚落发展而来。传统故事将其建城与罗摩之子俱舍联系起来，但有历史记载的城镇始于1525年，当时来自喀布尔的赫什吉普什图人在此定居。莫卧儿统治时期，这些堡垒与家族街区组成了一处繁盛的商业中心。苏菲诗人布莱·沙阿曾居住于卡苏尔，他的陵祠成为这里长久的地标。莫卧儿帝国衰落后，杜兰尼人与锡克人争夺此地；1807年，兰季特·辛格夺取了这座城镇。

english: The wider Koksoak country around Kasuswapaskau is shaped by northern Quebec’s largest river in Nunavik. Formed by the Caniapiscau and Rivière aux Mélèzes, the Koksoak flows into Ungava Bay; Kuujjuaq stands along its lower course.
simp_chinese: 卡苏斯瓦帕斯考周边更广阔的科克索克地区，以努纳维克最大的河流为地理骨架。科克索克河由卡尼亚皮斯科河与梅莱兹河汇成，流入昂加瓦湾；库朱阿克坐落在其下游岸边。

english: Kata Kuna belongs to the wider Mocoví lands of the Gran Chaco. These Guaycuru-speaking communities lived by fishing, hunting and gathering, with floods and poor soils limiting cultivation. Jesuit missions later encouraged cattle raising and farming, changing patterns of settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡塔库纳属于大查科更广阔的莫科维土地。这些属于瓜伊库鲁族群的社群以捕鱼、狩猎与采集为生，洪水和贫瘠土壤限制了耕作。耶稣会传教团后来推广养牛与农业，改变了聚居方式。

english: Katagata belongs to Mino, one of the ancient provinces included in Tōsandō. This division of Japan was also a road system connecting the provincial capitals through the country’s central mountain regions.
simp_chinese: 方县属于美浓，即古代东山道包含的令制国之一。日本这一地区区划同时也是道路体系，穿过中部山地，连接各国国府。

english: Katahdin is Maine’s highest mountain and takes its name from the Penobscot expression for “Great Mountain.” Its granite massif supports fragile alpine tundra near the summit.
simp_chinese: 卡塔丁山是缅因州最高峰，山名来自佩诺布斯科特语中的“大山”。花岗岩山体的峰顶附近分布着脆弱的高山苔原。

english: Kataka belongs to Odisha on the eastern side of India. The wider region is associated with ancient Kalinga and the war fought there after Ashoka invaded in 261 BCE.
simp_chinese: 卡塔卡属于印度东部的奥里萨地区。该地区与古代羯陵伽相联系，阿育王于公元前261年入侵后，这里爆发了羯陵伽战争。

english: Katanga belongs to the wider Moxico region of eastern Angola. The provincial center is Luena, while the eastern borderlands historically connected this sparsely populated territory with Zambia.
simp_chinese: 加丹加属于安哥拉东部更广阔的莫希科地区。省域中心为卢埃纳，东部边境地带使这片人口稀疏的地域与赞比亚相联系。

english: Katara belongs to the southwestern Angolan country around Namibe. The nearby coastal centre of Moçâmedes stands close to the Namib Desert, where cool, dry conditions support desert vegetation.
simp_chinese: 卡塔拉属于安哥拉西南部纳米贝周边地区。附近的沿海中心莫萨梅德斯靠近纳米布沙漠，凉爽干燥的条件形成了沙漠植被环境。

english: The Katataibo Jungle lies within the broader eastern Andean setting. The Andes run along western South America and consist of multiple ranges divided by intermediate depressions.
simp_chinese: 卡塔泰博丛林位于广义的东安第斯地理背景中。安第斯山脉沿南美洲西部延伸，由多条山系构成，其间分布着洼地。

english: Katataskatikw belongs to the Caniapiscau country of northern Quebec. The regional lake name comes from a Cree or Innu term meaning rocky point. Hunters and fur traders frequented Lake Caniapiscau before its flooding to create a much larger reservoir in 1981.
simp_chinese: 卡塔塔斯卡蒂库属于魁北克北部卡尼亚皮斯科地区。地区湖名来自意为岩石岬角的克里语或因努语词。猎人与毛皮商人曾频繁活动于卡尼亚皮斯科湖，1981年湖泊被淹，形成更大水库。

english: Kataysky belongs to the Kurgan country on the eastern side of the Urals. The modern name identifies a district, distinct from the similarly named village of Katayskoye in the Nizhny Novgorod region.
simp_chinese: 卡泰斯基位于乌拉尔东侧的库尔干地区。现代名称指一个地区，与下诺夫哥罗德地区名称相近的卡泰斯科耶村相区别。

english: Kate belongs to the New Guinea portion of Melanesia. In the distant past, New Guinea and Australia formed the single landmass of Sahul, joined by land exposed when sea levels were lower.
simp_chinese: 卡特属于美拉尼西亚的新几内亚部分。在遥远的过去，海平面较低时露出的陆地将新几内亚与澳大利亚连成名为萨胡尔的同一大陆。

english: Katen belongs to the Ussuri river country of eastern Manchuria. The wider river rises in the Sikhote-Alin and flows north to the Amur, fed by rainfall, snowmelt and springs; its Manchu name means soot-black river.
simp_chinese: 卡滕属于满洲东部乌苏里江地域。大河发源于锡霍特山，向北汇入黑龙江，水源来自降雨、融雪与泉水，满语名称意为“烟灰黑色的河”。

english: Katende belongs to the wider Moxico country of eastern Angola. The region is sparsely settled, with Luena serving as its principal administrative centre.
simp_chinese: 卡滕德属于安哥拉东部莫希科一带的广大地域。当地人口稀疏，卢埃纳是主要行政中心。

english: Katepwewi belongs to the Red River country on the northern plains. The wider plains extend through the southern Canadian provinces and northern United States, with prairie and steppe forming the western part of the continent’s vast Interior Plains.
simp_chinese: 卡特普维属于北方平原的红河地区。更广阔的平原横跨加拿大南部各省与美国北部，高草草原和干草原构成大陆辽阔内陆平原的西部。

english: Kath was one of the historic capitals of Khwarazm. The surrounding oasis country occupies the Amu Darya delta between the Aral Sea, Kyzylkum, Karakum and Ustyurt.
simp_chinese: 柯提是花剌子模历史首都之一。周围绿洲地区占据咸海、克孜勒库姆、卡拉库姆与乌斯秋尔特之间的阿姆河三角洲。

english: Katha belongs to the wider Wuntho country of Upper Burma. Wuntho lay between the Ayeyarwady and Chindwin and bore a Shan name meaning 'city of the tiger'; in 1555 its governor was assigned to resist Bayinnaung's advancing conquest of the north.
simp_chinese: 杰沙属于上缅甸广义的温多地区。温多位于伊洛瓦底江与亲敦江之间，其掸语名称意为虎城；1555年，当地长官奉命抵抗勃应囊向北推进的征服。

english: Known in the medieval period as Kantipur, Kathmandu occupied a fertile basin on the routes between India and Tibet. Its Newar merchants carried goods across the Himalayas, while metalworkers, woodcarvers and religious artists made the valley's craftsmanship sought after far beyond Nepal. Under the Malla kings, rival valley capitals competed in temples, palaces, public squares and waterspouts; Kathmandu's Hanuman Dhoka palace was enlarged by Pratap Malla in the seventeenth century. The name Kathmandu comes from Kasthamandap, the wooden pavilion at a meeting of old trade routes in Maru Square. Gorkha forces conquered the city in 1768, and it became the capital of the expanding kingdom of Nepal.
simp_chinese: 加德满都在中世纪称为康提普尔，坐落于印度与西藏交通线上的肥沃盆地。尼瓦尔商人越过喜马拉雅山运送货物，金属工匠、木雕匠和宗教艺术家则让谷地的技艺远近闻名。马拉王朝时期，谷地诸都竞相修建寺庙、宫殿、广场和石制水口；十七世纪，普拉塔普·马拉扩建了加德满都的哈努曼多卡宫。加德满都之名源于马鲁广场上古老商道交会处的木亭卡斯塔曼达普。廓尔喀军队于1768年攻占此城，此后这里成为不断扩张的尼泊尔王国的首都。

english: Kathua lies on the plain below the Sivalik foothills, with the Ravi and Ujjh rivers nearby and higher ranges rising to the north. A seasonal watercourse, locally called a khad, divides the settlement into two parts. Their Dogri names preserve the view from either bank: Parliwand means the other side, while Orliwand means this side. Dogri remains the local vernacular, tying the town to the wider cultural landscape of Jammu. The position brings sharp seasonal contrasts, with hot summers and heavy monsoon rain on the windward side of the hills. The modern city has become an administrative and industrial centre, but its older division by the stream remains legible in the names of its quarters.
simp_chinese: 卡图阿位于西瓦利克山麓下的平原，附近有拉维河与乌杰河，北面则耸立着更高的山岭。一条当地称为khad的季节性溪流将聚落分为两部分。两岸的多格拉语名称保留了各自的视角：帕尔利万德意为“另一边”，奥尔利万德意为“这一边”。多格拉语仍是当地通用语言，将城镇与查谟更广阔的文化地域相连。这里的季节变化鲜明，夏日炎热，季风又为山地迎风面带来强降雨。现代卡图阿已发展为行政与工业中心，但被溪流划分的旧有格局，仍可从城区名称中辨认出来。

english: Katiba lies in the Mbunda country of southeastern Angola. Mbunda communities settled along tributaries of the Zambezi and developed several related dialect groups, while their migrations also carried them into Barotseland in present-day Zambia.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂巴位于安哥拉东南部的姆本达地域。姆本达社群沿赞比西河支流定居，形成多个相关方言群体；他们的迁徙也将族人带到了今日赞比亚的巴罗策兰。

english: Katibas lies in Sarawak on the island of Borneo. Its modern state constituency was created in 1977 and has returned representatives to the state assembly since 1979. The constituency encompasses seven polling districts, joining several local communities within one electoral area.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂巴斯位于婆罗洲的砂拉越。现代州议会选区于1977年设立，自1979年起选出州议员。选区包含七个投票区，将多个地方社群联结在同一选举区域之内。

english: Katihar stands on the eastern bank of the Kari Kosi in the low country of eastern Bihar, within the Mithila and Purnia region. The surrounding district is crossed by the Ganges, Kosi and Mahananda, while monsoon rains can flood its rural settlements. The city later gained particular importance under British rule as a metre-gauge railway junction connecting northern India with northern Bengal and the northeast. Railways added a new line of communication to this river-filled landscape. Hindi, Urdu, Bengali and Maithili are among the languages represented in the city, reflecting its position near several linguistic regions.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂哈尔坐落于比哈尔东部低地、卡里科西河东岸，属于密提拉与布尔尼亚地区。周围地区有恒河、科西河及默哈嫩达河流经，季风降雨有时使乡村聚落遭受洪水。后来在英国统治时期，该城成为连接印度北部、孟加拉北部与东北地区的重要米轨铁路枢纽，铁路为这一河流密布的地区增添了新的交通轴线。城中使用的语言包括印地语、乌尔都语、孟加拉语和迈蒂利语，体现了它处于多个语言区域邻接地带的位置。

english: Katima stands on the Zambezi in Namibia’s Caprivi country. Its Lozi name means quench the fire, referring to nearby rapids. Riverine vegetation supports tropical birds and monkeys, while the river once carried barges along a long inland transport route.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂马坐落于纳米比亚卡普里维地区的赞比西河畔。其洛齐语名称意为熄灭火焰，指向附近急流。河岸植被栖息着热带鸟类和猴群，河流过去承载着漫长内河运输路线上的驳船。

english: Katingan belongs to central Borneo’s Dayak country. The wider region later came under the Banjar Sultanate, while its Indigenous Dayak population remained central to the area’s identity and eventual administrative development.
simp_chinese: 卡廷安属于婆罗洲中部的达雅克人地区。广大地域后来受到班贾尔苏丹国统治，原住民达雅克人始终是地区身份及后来行政发展的核心部分。

english: Katiola stands in central Côte d’Ivoire in the Bandama region. In the modern period it became a regional administrative center, linked to the national railway as well as an airport.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂奥拉位于科特迪瓦中部的班达马地区。现代时期，它成为地区行政中心，并通过全国铁路网络及机场与外界联系。

english: Katobe a Mubebe belongs to the north-central Angolan world of the Ambundu. The wider Kimbundu-speaking population lives on highlands north of the Kwanza and across the Luanda–Malanje country. The royal title Ngola, used by a principal Ambundu kingdom, gave Angola its name.
simp_chinese: 卡托贝阿穆贝贝属于安哥拉中北部的安本杜世界。广阔的金本杜语居民生活在宽扎河以北高地及罗安达—马兰热地区。主要安本杜王国使用的王号Ngola，成为安哥拉国名的来源。

english: Katok belongs to the Derge region of Kham. The wider kingdom was an important religious and political centre of eastern Tibet, with its capital renowned for a printing house preserving Tibetan cultural traditions.
simp_chinese: 尕多属于康区德格地区。广义王国曾是藏地东部重要宗教与政治中心，其都城以保存藏文化传统的印经院闻名。

english: Katol stands west of Nagpur in Vidarbha, beside a countryside connected with the Jam and Wardha river valleys. Its mud fort is associated with the Gond dynasty, while local tradition links the name Kuntalapur with the legendary king Chandrahasa. The Chandika and Saraswati temples preserve the town's religious importance; the Chandika shrine is built in the Hemadpanthi style and decorated with carved deities and animals. In later commercial life, cotton drew produce from a wide tract of surrounding villages, and the weekly bazaar was also an important cattle market. Orange orchards added another distinctive crop to this agricultural trading town.
simp_chinese: 卡托尔位于维达尔巴、那格浦尔以西，周围乡野与贾姆河、瓦尔达河谷相联系。当地的土堡与贡德王朝有关，地方传统则把昆塔拉普尔这一旧称同传说中的旃陀罗诃娑王联系起来。旃迪迦与萨拉斯瓦蒂神庙体现了城镇的宗教地位；旃迪迦神庙采用赫马德潘特式建筑，饰有神祇与动物雕刻。在后来的商业生活中，棉花贸易将广大村落的物产汇集于此，每周集市也是重要的牲畜市场。橙园又为这座农业商镇增添了一种特色作物。

english: Katori belongs to the old province of Shimōsa in eastern Japan. Shimōsa formed part of the Tōkaidō and bordered Kazusa to the south, with its lands spanning the country north of the Bōsō Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 香取属于日本东部的古下总国。下总属于东海道，南邻上总，其土地横跨房总半岛以北地区。

english: Katou belongs to the northern island world historically called Ezo. Japanese usage extended the name beyond Honshu to Hokkaido and sometimes Sakhalin and the Kurils; Hokkaido retained the Ezo name until 1869, preserving an older perspective on Japan's northeastern frontier.
simp_chinese: 河东属于历史上称为虾夷的北方岛屿世界。日本文献将此名用于本州以北的北海道，有时也包括萨哈林与千岛；北海道直到1869年仍沿用虾夷之名，保留了日本对东北边地的旧有认识。

english: Katō belongs to Bitchū, an old province of western Japan. The wider province’s ancient capital and temples stood around Sōja, while later rival houses contested its lands during the age of warfare.
simp_chinese: 下道属于日本西部古代备中国。更广阔的备中地区古代国府与寺院位于总社一带，后来在战乱时代成为诸家争夺的土地。

english: Katrasgarh, also called Katras, lies among the undulating uplands of the Chota Nagpur country, with the Damodar flowing to the south of the surrounding region. The settlement stands at roughly 201 metres above sea level. Its familiar modern identity belongs to the coalfields around Dhanbad: collieries bearing names such as Salanpur, Keshalpur and Ramkanali formed part of the Katras mining area. These industrial workings belong to a later age, and should not be mistaken for the landscape of a medieval mining town. In 2006 Katras was joined with other urban settlements in the Dhanbad Municipal Corporation, marking another change in the administration of this upland settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡特拉斯加尔又称卡特拉斯，位于焦达纳格布尔一带起伏的高地之中，达摩达尔河流经周边地区的南部。聚落海拔约201米。它为现代人熟悉的面貌与丹巴德附近的煤田相连：萨兰普尔、凯沙尔普尔与拉姆卡纳利等煤矿组成了卡特拉斯矿区的一部分。这些工业开采活动属于较晚的时代，不宜据此想象中世纪的矿业城镇。2006年，卡特拉斯与其他城市聚落一同纳入丹巴德市政机构的管辖，为这座高地聚落的行政沿革添上新的一页。

english: Katrawunletuayin belongs to the broad Patagonian world. Across southern South America, the Andes divide western fjords and temperate rainforests from the dry tablelands and steppes that face the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 卡特劳恩莱图阿因属于广阔的巴塔哥尼亚世界。在南美南部，安第斯山将西部峡湾、温带雨林与面向大西洋的干燥台地和草原分开。

english: Katsina stands in the Hausa country where the Sudanian grasslands give way northward to the drier Sahel. The city belonged to the Hausa Bakwai tradition, and by the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries it had become an important centre of trade and Islamic learning alongside Daura. The Gobarau Minaret remains a conspicuous expression of that religious heritage. Around the towns, millet and sorghum fields share the savanna with cattle, sheep and goats. The Fulani jihad of the early nineteenth century brought Katsina into the Sokoto Caliphate as an emirate, adding a new political order to a much older Hausa centre.
simp_chinese: 卡齐纳坐落在豪萨腹地，这里的苏丹稀树草原向北渐变为更加干旱的萨赫勒。城镇属于传统的豪萨七邦，十五至十六世纪间，与道拉一同成为贸易和伊斯兰学术的重要中心。戈巴劳宣礼塔至今仍鲜明体现着这份宗教遗产。城镇周围，黍与高粱田同牛、绵羊和山羊牧群共同分布在草原上。十九世纪初的富拉尼圣战使卡齐纳以埃米尔国身份纳入索科托哈里发国，为这座历史悠久的豪萨中心带来新的政治秩序。

english:
Katsina-Ala stands beside the river of the same name, a major tributary of the Benue. Its riverbank community includes Tiv, Etulo, Hausa and Fulani inhabitants, with Tiv serving as a principal language of communication. The surrounding district supports a network of markets whose gatherings fall on different days of the week.

Beneath this inhabited landscape lie traces of a much older world. Terracotta heads and fragments of larger figures discovered here in the twentieth century belong to the Nok cultural tradition, though the Katsina-Ala pieces display a distinctive style. Iron working began at the site in the fourth century BCE, and excavators also found smelted tin beads, some possibly imitating cowrie shells. The figures are thought to have represented ancestors or spirits, preserving a glimpse of beliefs far older than the later town.
simp_chinese:
卡齐纳阿拉坐落在同名河流岸边，这条河是贝努埃河的重要支流。河畔社群包括蒂夫人、埃图洛人、豪萨人和富拉尼人，蒂夫语是主要交流语言之一。周边地区分布着一系列市场，各自在一周中的不同日子开集。

这片有人居住的土地之下，还留有更古老世界的痕迹。二十世纪在此发现的陶制人头和大型塑像残片属于诺克文化传统，卡齐纳阿拉的作品又呈现出独特风格。遗址在公元前四世纪开始冶铁；考古人员还发现了熔炼制成的锡珠，其中一些可能模仿宝贝贝壳。塑像被认为表现祖先或神灵，留下了远早于后世城镇的信仰片影。

english: Katsushika occupies low alluvial country threaded by the Edogawa, Arakawa, Ayasegawa and Nakagawa. The name once denoted a much broader district than the modern Tokyo ward: later divisions left parts in the territories now administered from Saitama and Chiba, while southern Katsushika included land now belonging to several eastern Tokyo wards. The present ward was created only in the twentieth century. Among the religious landmarks preserved within its bounds are Kasai Shrine and Shibamata Taishakuten, reminders that the settlements of this river plain have identities older than their modern municipal boundaries.
simp_chinese: 葛饰所在的低平冲积地带河流纵横，江户川、荒川、绫濑川和中川穿行其间。葛饰这一名称过去指向的郡域，远大于今天的东京葛饰区；后来的区划将部分土地划入今埼玉、千叶所辖地区，南葛饰也曾包括如今属于东京东部数区的土地。现今的葛饰区直到20世纪才成立。区内保留的葛西神社与柴又帝释天等宗教地标，承载着这片河川平原上早于现代行政边界的聚落身份。

english: Katta belongs to the northeastern Honshu region known as Tōhoku. The wider country has a reputation for a harsh climate and was historically divided between the Dewa and Mutsu worlds.
simp_chinese: 刈田属于本州东北部的东北地区。广义地区以严酷气候著称，历史上分属出羽与陆奥的世界。

english: Kattashor Lake belongs to the Khiva region of Khwarazm. The nearby regional centre has been inhabited for more than 2,500 years and became a capital of Khwarazm and later the Khanate of Khiva.
simp_chinese: 卡塔绍尔湖属于花剌子模的希瓦地区。附近的地区中心已有超过2500年的居住历史，后来成为花剌子模及希瓦汗国的都城。

english:
Between Jutland and the Swedish shore, the Kattegat gathers the waters leaving the Baltic through the Danish Straits before they reach the Skagerrak. Its shallow seabed, crowded with sandy and stony reefs, and its shifting currents make this small sea an exacting passage. The islands of Samsø, Læsø and Anholt interrupt the crossing, while lighter Baltic water runs above saltier water entering from the north.

For centuries this was the sea approach to the Baltic; only the completion of the Eider Canal in 1784 offered a different seaborne connection. From 1429 Denmark drew substantial revenue from vessels passing through the Sound. Even the name recalls the difficulties of navigation: late medieval seafarers used the Dutch words for a cat and a narrow passage to describe waters hemmed in by shoals.
simp_chinese:
卡特加特位于日德兰半岛与瑞典海岸之间，波罗的海水穿过丹麦诸海峡后在此汇集，继而流向斯卡格拉克。浅海床遍布沙礁和石礁，水流变化无常，使这片不大的海域成为考验航海技术的通道。萨姆索、莱斯和安霍尔特诸岛散布其间，较轻的波罗的海水流经表层，较咸的北方来水则从深处进入。

数百年间，这里一直是进入波罗的海的海上门户，直到1784年艾德运河建成才出现另一条水路。自1429年起，丹麦从经过厄勒海峡的船只身上获取可观税收。海域名称本身也留下航行艰难的印记：中世纪晚期的航海者用荷兰语中猫与狭窄通道的词语，形容被浅滩挤压的航路。

english: Katugino belongs to the broader Stanovoy highland country around the Kodar ranges. The Kodar Mountains stand between the Vitim and Chara rivers in an earthquake-prone part of the Baikal Rift Zone.
simp_chinese: 卡图吉诺属于科达尔山脉周边更广阔的斯塔诺夫高地。科达尔山脉位于维季姆河与恰拉河之间，属于贝加尔裂谷带中地震活跃的一段。

english: Katumbele belongs to the Ovimbundu country of Angola’s Bié Plateau. Across the wider region, Bantu communities developed local political groups including Wambo and Bailundo. Sophisticated farming combined with the keeping of goats, pigs, chickens and cattle supported their permanent settlements.
simp_chinese: 卡通贝莱属于安哥拉比耶高原的奥温本杜地区。在更广阔区域内，班图社群发展出万博、拜伦多等地方政治群体。成熟农业结合山羊、猪、鸡和牛的饲养，支撑着永久聚落。

english: Katwe lies near Kampala between the districts of Mengo, Nsambya and Makindye. By Ugandan independence in 1962 it was known for artisans who repaired imported machinery and appliances, sometimes improvising locally made substitutes.
simp_chinese: 卡特韦位于坎帕拉附近，处于门戈、恩桑比亚与马金迪耶等地之间。至1962年乌干达独立时，这里已以维修进口机械及家用设备的工匠闻名，他们有时还自行制作替代零件与仿制品。

english: Katyn belongs to the Smolensk country of western Russia. Smolensk stands on the Dnieper and lay on the medieval route from the Varangians to the Greeks.
simp_chinese: 卡廷属于俄罗斯西部的斯摩棱斯克地区。斯摩棱斯克坐落在第聂伯河畔，位于中世纪从瓦良格人到希腊人的交通路线上。

english: Katzenelnbogen grew around a medieval castle in the Taunus country, but the wealth of its counts reached far beyond the small town. Lucrative toll rights on the Rhine helped raise the family among the region's leading nobles, while Rheinfels and other castles guarded their wider interests. Their accounts also preserve a celebrated detail of wine history: a 1435 entry records the purchase of Riesling vines. When the male line ended in 1479, the county became the object of a long dispute between Hesse and Nassau. A modest castle town thus gave its name to possessions, revenue rights and dynastic claims scattered across a much larger landscape.
simp_chinese: 卡岑埃尔恩博根围绕陶努斯地区的一座中世纪城堡发展起来，但伯爵家族的财富远远超出小城本身。莱茵河上收益丰厚的关税权，使这一家族跻身地区显贵，莱茵费尔斯等城堡则保护着他们更广泛的利益。其账簿还保存了葡萄酒史上一项著名细节：1435年的记录提到购买雷司令葡萄藤。1479年男性世系断绝后，伯国成为黑森与拿骚长期争执的对象。一座并不庞大的城堡城镇，就这样为散布在更广大地域中的领地、收益权和王朝继承主张提供了名称。

english: The Katzie homeland lies in the Lower Fraser Valley, embracing the Pitt and Alouette watersheds and lands along the Fraser. Its name, q̓ic̓əy̓, means the land of the moss or the many-coloured moss. Katzie oral tradition traces the people chiefly to the communities of Oeʼlecten at Pitt Lake and Swaneset at Sheridan Hill. In these accounts, Swaneset shaped a country rich in berries and edible roots, while marriages linking earth, sky and the salmon people explain the abundance of eulachon and sockeye. These traditions bind village life to the waters and food-bearing lands of the valley. The Katzie speak the downriver form of Halkomelem, a Coast Salish language.
simp_chinese: 卡齐人的故土位于弗雷泽河下游谷地，涵盖皮特河与阿卢埃特河流域，以及弗雷泽河沿岸土地。其本族名称 q̓ic̓əy̓ 意为“苔藓之地”或“多彩的苔藓”。卡齐口述传统主要将族人的起源追溯至皮特湖畔的欧莱克滕社群与谢里登山的斯瓦内塞特社群。故事中的斯瓦内塞特塑造了盛产浆果和可食根茎的土地，而连接大地、天空与鲑鱼族的婚姻，则解释了蜡烛鱼和红鲑的丰饶。这些传统把村落生活与河谷的水域及出产食物的土地紧密相连。卡齐人使用海岸萨利希语系哈尔科梅勒姆语的下游方言。

english: Kauaʻi rises northwest of Oʻahu, an old volcanic island whose deeply eroded landscape includes the great Waimea Canyon. Polynesian settlement preceded the arrival of James Cook, whose ships anchored in Waimea Bay in January 1778 to obtain water and food. Iron was especially prized in these first exchanges; even a nail could purchase plentiful provisions. Kauaʻi subsequently resisted incorporation into Kamehameha's expanding kingdom. Storms defeated one projected invasion and disease disrupted another, leaving its ruler Kaumualiʻi independent until he accepted vassalage by agreement in 1810. A later attempt by an agent of the Russian-American Company to secure Russian protection and exclusive trading rights ended with the agent's expulsion in 1817. In 1835, a sugar plantation and mill at Kōloa marked the beginning of another far-reaching change in the island's economy.
simp_chinese: 考艾岛位于瓦胡岛西北，是一座古老的火山岛，深受侵蚀的地貌中包括雄伟的威美亚峡谷。波利尼西亚人在此定居，远早于詹姆斯·库克的到来；库克的船只于1778年1月停泊威美亚湾，补充淡水和食物。早期交易中，铁器尤其珍贵，一枚铁钉便能换得大量给养。此后，考艾岛抵抗了卡美哈梅哈王国的扩张。风暴挫败了一次入侵计划，疾病又打乱了另一次，使统治者考穆阿利伊得以保持独立，直到1810年协议接受臣属地位。后来，一名俄美公司代理人试图以俄国保护换取独占贸易权，最终在1817年遭到驱逐。1835年，科洛阿的甘蔗种植园与糖厂建立，预示着岛上经济又一次深刻变化的开端。

english: Kauakiekamatsh belongs to the Cree country around Waskaganish on southeastern James Bay. In the wider homeland, small family hunting groups moved among seasonal fishing and hunting camps, often remaining close to river watersheds.
simp_chinese: 考瓦基卡马奇属于詹姆斯湾东南部瓦斯卡加尼什周围的克里地区。在更广阔的故土，小型家庭狩猎群体在季节性渔猎营地之间迁移，往往贴近河流流域生活。

english: Kaudwane is a village of Botswana’s Kalahari country. It lies roughly 220 kilometers northwest of Gaborone in the Kweneng district, with a small settled community recorded there in modern censuses.
simp_chinese: 考德瓦内是博茨瓦纳卡拉哈里地区的一座村落。它位于奎嫩区、哈博罗内西北约220公里处，现代人口普查记录了当地的小型定居社群。

english: Kauehi, also called Putake, is a Tuamotu atoll whose narrow ring of land encloses a lagoon twenty-four kilometres long and eighteen wide. A single navigable pass gives access to the sheltered water, while nearby Raraka lies only seventeen kilometres to the southeast. Pearl traders may have known the atoll before its first recorded European visit, made by Robert FitzRoy of the Beagle in 1835. The United States Exploring Expedition later called here, and Charles Wilkes named it Vincennes after his ship. Tearavero is its principal village, set amid an expanse of lagoon far larger than the atoll's dry land.
simp_chinese: 考埃希又名普塔凯，是一座土阿莫土环礁，狭窄的陆地环抱着长二十四公里、宽十八公里的潟湖。这里只有一道可供船只通行的水道，通往环礁内的水域；东南十七公里外便是拉拉卡环礁。珍珠商人或许早已知道这里，但有记录的首位欧洲来访者，是1835年乘“小猎犬”号抵达的罗伯特·菲茨罗伊。美国探险远征队后来也曾到访，查尔斯·威尔克斯以自己的船名将其称作“文森斯”。主要村落泰拉韦罗坐落于环礁之上，周围潟湖的面积远远超过露出水面的陆地。

english: The western Tuamotu waters include the great atoll of Fakarava. Its deep lagoon communicates with the sea through two passes.
simp_chinese: 土阿莫土西部水域包含大型法卡拉瓦环礁。深潟湖经两道入口与海洋相通。

english: Kauipushkakamat belongs to the Labrador region of northeastern Canada. The wider region is home to Inuit and Innu peoples, whose early settlement connected coastal life with journeys into the interior.
simp_chinese: 考伊普什卡卡马特属于加拿大东北部的拉布拉多地区。广大地区是因纽特人和因努人的故土，早期生活既与沿海相连，也包含向内陆的行旅。

english: Kaukou belongs to the Karoo country of southern Africa. This semidesert region is marked by dry air, sparse rain and severe temperature changes; fossil-bearing strata of the Karoo Supergroup reveal environments dating from the Permian to the early Jurassic.
simp_chinese: 考科属于非洲南部的卡鲁地区。这片半沙漠以干燥空气、稀少降雨与剧烈温差为特色；卡鲁超群的含化石地层展现了从二叠纪至早侏罗世的环境。

english: Kaukura stretches across the western Tuamotus as a long, low enclosure of reef and islets. Its northern rim is narrow, its southern side broader, and the great lagoon has only one navigable entrance through the surrounding coral. Fishing sustained island life among these scattered strips of land; Motu Panao lies towards the northwest, with Apataki the nearest neighbouring atoll. Jakob Roggeveen reached Kaukura in 1722 while searching for the southern continent. His expedition encountered a settled ocean landscape whose narrow passes and lagoon waters mattered more to its inhabitants than any imagined continent.
simp_chinese: 考库拉环礁位于土阿莫土群岛西部，由低矮而狭长的礁盘与小岛围成。北缘较窄，南侧较宽，包围广大潟湖的珊瑚礁仅留下一道可供船只通行的入口。捕鱼支撑着散布于条条陆地上的岛民生活，帕瑙岛在西北部，邻近的阿帕塔基则是最近的另一座环礁。1722年，雅各布·罗赫芬寻找南方大陆时来到这里。他遇见的是一片已有居民生活的大洋环境；对岛民而言，狭窄航口与潟湖水域远比想象中的大陆更为切身。

english: Kaulas belongs to the wider Telugu country associated with Warangal. That regional centre was the capital of the Kakatiya dynasty, and its older name Orugallu referred to the great granite boulder within its fort.
simp_chinese: 考拉斯属于与瓦朗加尔相联系的泰卢固地区。瓦朗加尔曾是卡卡提亚王朝的首都，其旧名奥鲁加卢指城堡内的巨大花岗岩。

english: Kaulong communities inhabit the southwestern interior of New Britain near Kandrian. Their language belongs to the Austronesian family and is also known as Pasismanua. Shifting cultivation is a characteristic part of their livelihood in this island hinterland.
simp_chinese: 考隆社群居住在坎德里安附近的新不列颠岛西南部内陆。其语言属于南岛语系，又称帕西斯马努阿语。轮垦是这片岛屿腹地社群生计的一项特色。

english:
At the meeting of the Nemunas and Neris, Kaunas commands a river junction that drew both merchants and armies into Lithuania. Its castle guarded the approaches to the country's interior, but fell to the Teutonic Order after a siege in 1362. The struggle for nearby strongholds continued for decades before Lithuanian control became secure.

Vytautas granted the town Magdeburg rights in 1408, together with valuable rights over weighing goods, processing wax and finishing woollen cloth. A Hanseatic merchant office opened here in 1441, linking the river port to western European commerce. Trade brought masonry houses, churches and prosperity, although later wars, plague and fires repeatedly broke the city's growth. Even the castle's walls faced an enemy beyond armies: river erosion undermined part of the fortress in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese:
考纳斯位于尼曼河与涅里斯河交汇处，这处水路枢纽吸引商旅，也引来进入立陶宛的军队。城堡守护通往内地的门户，却在1362年遭条顿骑士团围攻后陷落。附近要塞的争夺又持续数十年，立陶宛才牢固掌握这一带。

维陶塔斯于1408年授予城镇马格德堡法权利，同时给予称量货物、加工蜡料和整理呢绒等有利可图的权利。汉萨商馆于1441年在此开设，将河港接入西欧商业网络。贸易带来砖石住宅、教堂与繁荣，后来的战争、瘟疫和火灾又屡次打断发展。城堡还面临军队之外的威胁：十八世纪，河水侵蚀使部分城墙失去支撑而坍塌。

english: Kauō, called Laysan by later mariners, is a low island in the northwestern Hawaiian chain. Coral growth and uplift formed a rim of land around an enclosed salt lake, with reefs beyond and a large dune towards the north. The Hawaiian name means 'egg'. Its lake is far saltier than the sea, making fresh water a less obvious resource than the surrounding abundance of birds. Rainwater can rest above denser salt water near the shore; watching where the finches drink offers a clue to finding it in this isolated ocean refuge.
simp_chinese: 考奥岛后来被航海者称为莱桑，位于夏威夷群岛西北段。珊瑚生长与地面抬升形成一圈陆地，包围封闭的盐湖，外侧环绕珊瑚礁，北部则堆起一片较大的沙丘。夏威夷语岛名意为“蛋”。湖水远比海水咸，寻找淡水因而不像发现成群鸟类那样容易。雨水可以浮在密度更大的咸水之上，在湖岸附近汇集；观察雀鸟到哪里饮水，便能在这片孤悬大洋的栖息地找到线索。

english: The coast of Kauō lies among the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. Small islands and atolls in this ocean region provide habitat for distinctive Hawaiian wildlife, while surrounding seas sustain rich reef communities.
simp_chinese: 考奥海岸位于夏威夷西北群岛之中。这片洋区的小岛与环礁为独特的夏威夷野生生物提供栖息地，周围海域则孕育丰富的珊瑚礁生物群落。

english: Kaurna pangkarra is associated with the traditional country of the Kaurna on South Australia’s Adelaide Plains. Local family groups spoke dialects of a shared language and were known by names linked to their particular places.
simp_chinese: 考纳潘卡拉与南澳大利亚阿德莱德平原上考纳人的传统地域有关。当地各家庭群体使用同一语言的不同方言，并以与各自地方相联的名称为人所知。

english: Kausseskait belongs to the broader Innu homeland of northeastern Quebec and Labrador. Innu communities followed seasonal hunting migrations, using portable animal-skin tents and relying on caribou, moose and smaller game across the country they call Nitassinan, “our land”.
simp_chinese: 考斯凯特属于魁北克东北部与拉布拉多更广阔的因努人家园。因努社群随季节迁徙狩猎，使用便携的兽皮帐篷，依靠驯鹿、驼鹿与小型猎物为生，并称自己的土地为Nitassinan，即“我们的土地”。

english:
Kaustby, known in Finnish as Kaustinen, lies in Ostrobothnia among the communities of Kokkola, Kronoby, Halsua and Veteli. Its separate municipal charter dates to 1866, after the period of early modern kingdoms, and should not be mistaken for evidence of a medieval chartered town.

The locality is especially associated with Finnish folk music and fiddling. A violin on its municipal arms recalls that continuing tradition, which later found an international audience through the annual folk music festival. The kantele player and songwriter Kreeta Haapasalo, born in 1813, is among the musicians associated with Kaustby.
simp_chinese:
考斯特比的芬兰语名为Kaustinen，位于奥斯特罗博滕，与科科拉、克鲁努皮、哈尔苏阿和韦泰利等地为邻。它取得独立市镇章程是在1866年，已晚于近代早期诸王国的时代，不能据此将它视为拥有中世纪特许状的城镇。

这里尤其以芬兰民间音乐与小提琴演奏传统著称。市镇纹章上的小提琴纪念着这一延续至今的传统，后来的年度民间音乐节又将其带给国际听众。1813年出生的康特勒琴演奏家兼歌曲作者克丽塔·哈帕萨洛，也是与考斯特比有关的音乐家之一。

english: The Kauthara coastal country is represented by Khánh Hòa, where lowlands around Ninh Hòa meet wooded mountains and the South China Sea. Farming occupies only part of the landscape, while forests cover much of its extent. The region’s geography joins narrow coastal plains to a rugged inland margin.
simp_chinese: 古笪罗沿海地区对应庆和一带，宁和附近的低地在此连接林木覆盖的山地与南海。耕地只占景观的一部分，大片土地仍为森林覆盖。当地地理将狭窄沿海平原与崎岖内陆边缘联系起来。

english: Kautokeino belongs to Finnmark, a northern Norwegian part of the larger Sámi homeland of Sápmi. The county’s name derives from Old Norse terms for the Sámi people and their woodland or borderland.
simp_chinese: 考托凯诺位于挪威北部的芬马克，属于更广大萨米故土萨普米的一部分。芬马克名称源于古诺斯语中表示萨米人及其林地或边疆的词。

english: Kauwes belongs to the far southern Patagonian world. Across this wider region, the Andes and western fjords give way to eastern plateaus and steppe, between the Pacific and Atlantic oceans.
simp_chinese: 考维斯属于遥远南方的巴塔哥尼亚地域。在这一广大地区，安第斯山脉与西部峡湾向东过渡为高原和草原，地域横跨太平洋与大西洋之间。

english: Kavajë stands on Albania's western lowlands, south of the Bay of Durrës and within reach of the Adriatic coast. Its name appears in the Ottoman land register of 1431–1432, while the surrounding country had earlier been divided among the Skuraj and Matrangaj families. By the seventeenth century it had become a prosperous market town serving the coastal plain. Visiting in 1670, Evliya Çelebi described gardens, vineyards and stone houses, with merchants arriving from Durrës and Bashtovë. He counted some two hundred shops beneath the shade of mulberry trees and two stone-built inns where travelling traders offered cloth. Mosques, religious schools and dervish lodges stood alongside this commercial life; the clock tower built in 1817 added a later landmark to a town sustained by the produce and traffic of its hinterland.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦亚坐落于阿尔巴尼亚西部低地，位于都拉斯湾以南，靠近亚得里亚海岸。其名见于1431至1432年的奥斯曼土地登记册；更早时，周边地区曾由斯库拉伊与马特兰加伊家族分据。到十七世纪，这里已成为服务沿海平原的繁荣市镇。埃夫利亚·切莱比在1670年来访时，记下了园圃、葡萄园与石砌住宅，以及从都拉斯和巴什托瓦前来的商人。他记述桑树荫下约有二百间店铺，还有两座供行商出售布匹的石砌客栈。清真寺、宗教学校与苏菲修院伴随商业生活而兴盛；1817年建起的钟楼，则为这座依靠腹地物产和往来交通维生的城镇增添了新的标志。

english: Kavala looks across its bay toward Thasos, whose settlers founded the port of Neapolis in the late seventh century BC. Gold and silver in the nearby mountains helped draw these colonists to the Macedonian coast. The Via Egnatia later carried Roman traffic through the town, joining its harbour to an overland artery of commerce. In Byzantine times it was known as Christoupolis, and inscriptions record the repair of its battered walls. Ottoman forces captured it in 1387; in the sixteenth century, Ibrahim Pasha helped revive the town by rebuilding its aqueduct, while the fortress above Panagia was enlarged. The harbour also belonged to the early life of Muhammad Ali, whose family lived here before he established a ruling dynasty in Egypt.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦拉隔着海湾与萨索斯岛相望，公元前7世纪末，来自该岛的移民在此建立了尼亚波利斯港。附近山地的金银矿吸引殖民者来到马其顿海岸。后来，罗马的埃格纳提亚大道穿城而过，将港口与陆上商路连为一体。拜占庭时期，此城称为克里斯托波利斯，碑铭记载了其残破城墙的修复。奥斯曼军队于1387年攻占这里；16世纪，易卜拉欣帕夏重建引水渠，帮助城镇恢复繁荣，帕纳吉亚山上的堡垒也得到扩建。穆罕默德·阿里的早年生活同样与这座港口相连：在他赴埃及建立统治王朝之前，其家族曾居住于此。

english: Kavalan belongs to Taiwan, the island historically known abroad as Formosa. Mountains dominate the island’s eastern two-thirds, contrasting with the plains of its western side.
simp_chinese: 噶玛兰属于台湾，这座岛屿在海外历史上也称福尔摩沙。山地占据岛屿东部约三分之二，与西侧平原形成对照。

english:
Kavali lies on the low coastal plain of Andhra, only about eight kilometres inland from the Bay of Bengal. Its Telugu name carries the sense of protection or security. The name is linked to an army stationed here in 1515 by Harihara Rayulu, king of Udayagiri, preserving the memory of a military encampment in a town close to the eastern sea.

The settlement stands scarcely above sea level and belongs to the coastal country north of Nellore. Its setting joins the inland world of Udayagiri to the broad, hot plain along the Bay of Bengal.
simp_chinese:
卡瓦利位于安得拉低平的滨海平原上，距孟加拉湾仅约八公里。它的泰卢固语名称含有保护或守卫之意。地名与乌达亚吉里国王哈里哈拉·拉尤卢于1515年在此驻军的往事相联系，使这座临近东海的城镇保留了军营的记忆。

聚落的海拔仅略高于海平面，属于内洛尔以北的沿海地带。这里的地理位置将乌达亚吉里的内陆腹地与孟加拉湾畔宽阔炎热的平原联系起来。

english: Kavanga belongs to Kongo’s Wizi country. In the wider kingdom, farming Bakongo communities developed metalworking, pottery and raffia weaving, while rulers collected tribute and encouraged interregional trade.
simp_chinese: 卡万加属于刚果的维济地区。在更广阔的王国，从事农业的巴刚果社群发展了金属加工、陶器与拉菲草编织，统治者则征收贡赋并促进跨地区贸易。

english: Kavar lies in the Fars region of southern Iran. In modern administration it serves as the centre of a county formerly included within the Shiraz district system.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦尔位于伊朗南部的法尔斯地区。如今它是一个县的中心，该县早先曾属于设拉子的行政体系。

english: Kavaratti lies off India’s Malabar coast in the Lakshadweep islands. Its principal settlement serves as the territory’s capital, and coral reefs and a lagoon surround the low island.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦拉蒂位于印度马拉巴尔海岸外侧的拉克沙群岛。主要聚落是这一地区的首府，珊瑚礁与潟湖环绕着低矮岛屿。

english: At the northern tip of New Ireland, Balgai Bay opens among the islands separating New Ireland from New Hanover. Nusa Lik, Nusa Lawa and other small islands can be seen from the shore around Kavieng. Dutch explorers charted this coast in 1616, but the town itself belongs to a much later period: the German colonial administration founded it in the early twentieth century. Copra plantations and a port for exporting their produce subsequently helped shape its fortunes. The sheltered island setting thus has a longer maritime history than the modern settlement whose name now marks it.
simp_chinese: 新爱尔兰岛北端的巴尔盖湾面向新爱尔兰与新汉诺威之间的群岛。从卡维恩附近的岸边，可以望见努萨利克、努萨拉瓦等小岛。荷兰探险者于1616年测绘了这片海岸，但城镇本身的建立远在其后：德国殖民当局直到20世纪初才创建卡维恩。椰干种植园及其出口港随后塑造了当地的发展。这片群岛环绕的海岸，其航海历史远比今日标示此地的城镇悠久。

english: Kavitaha belongs to the Merina highlands of Madagascar. The wider Merina people speak an Austronesian Malagasy dialect and reflect the island’s long interaction between settlers from maritime Southeast Asia, African migrants and later arrivals.
simp_chinese: 卡维塔哈属于马达加斯加梅里纳高地。更广阔的梅里纳族群使用南岛语族马达加斯加语的一种方言，体现了海洋东南亚移民、非洲迁入者及后来来客在岛上的长期交往。

english: Kaw lies in the broad central Great Plains setting. This mixed-grass prairie belt extends through Kansas and neighbouring states, between the taller grasslands to the east and the shorter western prairies; few trees interrupt its extensive open country.
simp_chinese: 卡位于广义的中部大平原地区。混生草原地带延伸穿过堪萨斯及邻近各州，介于东部高草原与西部矮草原之间；广阔开阔地上树木稀少。

english: Kawabe lies in the country of Settsu, within the wider modern Hyōgo region of Kansai. Hyōgo stretches across Honshu from the Sea of Japan to the Seto Inland Sea. Its southern cities, including Kobe, Nishinomiya and Amagasaki, form part of the great Osaka urban region.
simp_chinese: 川边位于摄津地域，属于关西现代兵库县的广大范围。兵库横跨本州，从日本海延至濑户内海。南部的神户、西宫和尼崎等城市构成大阪都市圈的一部分。

english: Kawachi belongs to Shimotsuke, one of the ancient provinces of Japan's Tōsandō region. The same name Tōsandō referred both to this geographical division and to the road network connecting its provincial centres.
simp_chinese: 河内属于下野，这是日本东山道地区的古代令制国之一。东山道这一名称既指地理行政分区，也指连接其各国中心的道路网络。

english: Kawachikamasu belongs to the wider Caniapiscau country of northern Quebec. The name Caniapiscau refers to a rocky point, and the old lake was frequented by hunters and fur traders before its expansion into a reservoir.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦奇卡马苏属于魁北克北部更广阔的卡尼亚皮斯科地区。卡尼亚皮斯科意为岩石岬角，在旧湖扩建为水库以前，猎人与皮毛商曾经常到访。

english: Kawachisakau belongs to the Caniapiscau lake country of northern Quebec. The regional name comes from a Cree or Innu expression for a rocky point; Lake Caniapiscau drew hunters and fur traders, and a Hudson’s Bay Company post operated there from 1834 to 1870.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦奇萨考属于魁北克北部卡尼亚皮斯考湖区。区域名称源自克里语或因努语的“岩石岬角”；卡尼亚皮斯考湖吸引猎人与皮毛商，哈得孙湾公司于1834至1870年在当地设有商站。

english: Kawahib belongs to the Ji-Parana river country of Rondonia. The wider river’s Tupi-derived name means Great River of Axes, referring to rocks resembling Indigenous axes; the Machado and Urupa meet within this inland river landscape.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦希布属于朗多尼亚日巴拉那河地区。河流的图皮语名称意为“斧头大河”，指向形似原住民石斧的岩石，马沙杜河与乌鲁帕河在这片内陆河流地域交汇。

english: Kawaiapan Bay belongs to the southeastern New Guinea maritime setting. In the wider Melanesian world, coastal settlement was shaped by interaction between long-established Papuan peoples and later Austronesian voyagers.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦亚潘湾属于新几内亚东南部海洋环境。在更广阔的美拉尼西亚世界，沿海定居受古老巴布亚族群与后来南岛航海者交流的影响。

english:
The Kawaiisu homeland straddles the Tehachapi Valley and the southern Sierra Nevada, reaching north towards Walker Pass and east into the northern Mojave Desert. Its people called themselves Nüwa, meaning the People; Kawaiisu was a name adopted through their Yokuts neighbours. Their Southern Numic language connected them most closely with the Chemehuevi to the east, while other neighbours spoke quite different tongues.

Before European contact, winter villages commonly held sixty to a hundred inhabitants. In warmer months, smaller groups dispersed through mountain and desert country to gather plants and hunt. Acorns formed the staple food, supplemented by other seeds, nuts and game, and food-gathering journeys reached as far as the Panamint country and the western edge of Death Valley. Friendly ties with the Kitanemuk and cooperative antelope drives with the Yokuts crossed the linguistic boundaries of this varied landscape.
simp_chinese:
卡瓦伊苏人的家园横跨特哈查皮谷地与内华达山脉南部，向北伸向沃克山口，向东进入莫哈韦沙漠北部。他们自称Nüwa，意为“人民”；卡瓦伊苏这一称呼则经由邻近的约库茨人传入。他们使用的南努米克语，与东面的切梅韦维人语言最为接近，其他邻族则说着差异更大的语言。

在欧洲人到来以前，冬季村落通常容纳六十至一百人。天气转暖后，人们分成小群，前往山地和沙漠采集植物、狩猎。橡子是主食，其他种子、坚果和猎物作为补充；采食行程远达帕纳明特地区与死亡谷西缘。他们与基塔内穆克人保持友好关系，也与约库茨人共同围猎羚羊，使交往跨越这片复杂地貌中的语言边界。

english: Kawakami belongs to the Kushiro river country of eastern Hokkaido. The wider region contains the Kushiro and Akan rivers, volcanic mountains and lakes, with the Kushiro wetlands lying inland from the Pacific coast.
simp_chinese: 川上属于北海道东部钏路河流地区。更广阔的区域拥有钏路川与阿寒川、火山山地及湖泊，钏路湿原位于太平洋海岸内侧。

english: Kawali served as a capital of the Sunda kingdom from the early fourteenth to the late fifteenth century. Its site lies on Mount Sawal's eastern slope near the source of the Citanduy, and late-fourteenth-century inscriptions preserve evidence of its royal past.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦利从十四世纪初至十五世纪末曾是巽他王国的都城。遗址位于萨瓦尔山东坡、芝丹杜伊河源头附近，十四世纪晚期的碑铭保存着王都历史的证据。

english: Kawanuma belongs to the Tōhoku region of northeastern Honshu. The wider region, also called Ōu, embraces the northern Japanese country now divided among six prefectures and known for its severe climate.
simp_chinese: 河沼属于本州东北部的东北地区。这片更大区域又称奥羽，涵盖如今分属六县的日本北部土地，以严酷气候著称。

english: Kawardha stands among the hills and forests of the country now called Chhattisgarh, near the celebrated Bhoramdeo temple. Raja Mahabali Singh founded Kawardha State in 1751, making this town the seat of a small principality. The settlement also became a centre of the Kabir Panth: many adherents lived here, and in 1806 its eighth guru, Haq Nam Saheb, established a religious seat in the town. A tradition derives the district name Kabirdham from Kabir's seat. The neighbouring temples and the later guru's establishment give Kawardha a religious history extending beyond its role as a princely capital.
simp_chinese: 格沃尔塔坐落于今恰蒂斯加尔的丘陵与森林之间，附近有著名的婆罗摩提婆神庙。拉贾·马哈巴利·辛格于1751年建立格沃尔塔邦，使该镇成为一个小邦国的统治中心。这里也是迦比尔教派的重要据点：许多信众居住于此，1806年，该派第八代上师哈克·纳姆·萨希布又在镇中设立宗教席位。一种传统说法认为，地区名称迦比尔达姆源自“迦比尔的道场”。周边神庙与后来的上师席位，共同构成了超出邦国都城身份的宗教历史。

english: Kawartha belongs to the broader eastern Ontario country. Indigenous occupation of this region extends back thousands of years, with archaeological evidence from the Point Peninsula complex. Anishinaabe, Algonquin and Haudenosaunee peoples were among the communities living in the wider region.
simp_chinese: 卡沃萨属于广义的东安大略地区。这里的原住民居住历史延续数千年，波因特半岛文化遗址提供了考古证据。阿尼希纳贝人、阿尔冈昆人与豪德诺索尼人都是更广阔区域的居民。

english: The waters off Nagato belong to the Sea of Japan's southern margin. Narrow straits regulate exchange with neighbouring seas, and the enclosed basin has much smaller tides than open Pacific shores.
simp_chinese: 长门岸外水域属于日本海南缘。狭窄海峡调节与邻海的交换，封闭海盆潮差远小于太平洋外岸。

english: Kawatinook belongs to the Peace River country, the traditional homeland of the Dane-zaa. The Peace rises in northern British Columbia and runs northeast through Alberta, joining the Athabasca delta system and ultimately the Mackenzie drainage.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦蒂努克属于皮斯河地区，这里是达内扎人的传统家园。皮斯河发源于不列颠哥伦比亚北部，向东北流经艾伯塔，进入阿萨巴斯卡三角洲水系，最终归入马更些河流域。

english: Kawawasukutisich belongs to Nunavik in northern Québec. This wider Inuit homeland lies north of the fifty-fifth parallel, and its name means great land in the local Inuktitut dialect.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦瓦苏库蒂西奇属于魁北克北部的努纳维克。这片更广阔的因纽特人家园位于北纬55度以北，其名称在当地因纽特语中意为广大土地。

english: Kaweinag belongs to the wider southern Papua country facing the Arafura Sea. This larger region follows the customary Anim Ha area, with Merauke as its principal economic centre.
simp_chinese: 卡韦纳格处于面向阿拉弗拉海的巴布亚南部广阔地区。整个区域对应传统的阿尼姆哈地区，以马老奇为主要经济中心。

english: Kawenote belongs to the Adirondack mountain country of northeastern New York. This dome-shaped massif contains more than a hundred peaks and thousands of lakes and smaller bodies of water amid boreal forest.
simp_chinese: 卡韦诺特属于纽约东北部的阿迪朗达克山地。这片穹状山体拥有一百多座山峰，北方森林间散布着数千处湖泊与小型水体。

english: Kawich belongs to the Great Basin country of Nevada. Across the wider region, crustal stretching created numerous north–south mountain ranges separated by flat valleys and closed basins.
simp_chinese: 卡维奇属于内华达的大盆地地区。在更广阔的地区，地壳拉伸形成众多南北向山脉，其间由平坦河谷与封闭盆地分隔。

english: Kawinaw belongs to northern Keewatin. At the wider regional scale, the name Keewatin recalls the north wind in Cree and Ojibwe. Its later administrative boundaries shifted repeatedly, and the remaining northern district ultimately became part of Nunavut in 1999.
simp_chinese: 卡维瑙属于北基韦廷。从整个区域看，基韦廷这一名称保留了克里语和奥吉布韦语中“北风”的含义。后来的行政边界多次变动，剩余的北部地区最终于1999年成为努纳武特的一部分。

english: Kawishiwi belongs to the country around Lake Superior, the highest and westernmost of the Great Lakes. The wider lake system drains through the St. Marys River into Lake Huron and ultimately reaches the Atlantic through the St. Lawrence.
simp_chinese: 卡维希维属于苏必利尔湖周边地区，该湖是五大湖中位置最西、水面最高的一座。更广阔的湖泊水系经圣玛丽河流入休伦湖，最终通过圣劳伦斯河抵达大西洋。

english: Kawkaban is a fortified town perched above the market settlement of Shibam in Yemen. It occupies the summit of cliffs overlooking a large agricultural plain.
simp_chinese: 考卡班是一座要塞城镇，高踞于也门希巴姆集镇之上。它占据俯瞰广阔农业平原的崖顶。

english: Kawliya belongs to the Pegu country of lower Myanmar. The wider region’s center was also known as Hanthawaddy, a name associated with a Burmese-Mon kingdom. Bago later became a Taungoo royal capital and is distinguished by its large pagodas.
simp_chinese: 高利亚属于缅甸南部的勃固地区。广阔区域的中心也称汉达瓦底，这个名称与缅族—孟族王国有关。勃固后来成为东吁王朝都城，并以大型佛塔著称。

english: Kawthaung occupies the southern tip of Burma's Tenasserim coast, facing Ranong across the river mouth, with mountainous country behind it and the Andaman Sea opening to the west. The district passed into British hands after the First Anglo-Burmese War of 1824–1826, and the headland became known as Victoria Point. The present town's development belongs chiefly to a later age: in 1865 an Arab–Malay party led by Nayuda Ahmed established a village and base here while collecting marine products around the Mergui Archipelago. Government offices followed from Maliwan in 1891, since that settlement's shallow creek was poorly suited to large vessels. The contrast between sheltered coastal anchorages and difficult inland terrain helps explain why this southern extremity looked so strongly towards the sea.
simp_chinese: 高当位于缅甸德林达依海岸最南端，隔河口与拉廊相望，背后是山地，西面则向安达曼海敞开。1824—1826年第一次英缅战争后，这一地区落入英国手中，岬角也被称为维多利亚角。今天城镇的发展主要属于更晚的时代：1865年，纳尤达·艾哈迈德率领一群阿拉伯人与马来人，在遍访丹老群岛采集海产时于此建立村落和基地。1891年，政府机关也从马里湾迁来，因为那里的小溪水浅，不便大船出入。沿岸锚地与崎岖内陆的鲜明差别，说明这片南方尽头为何始终与海洋紧密相连。

english: Kaxa Marca, or Cajamarca, stands in Peru’s northern highlands in the Mashcon valley, about 2,750 metres above sea level. Its fertile surroundings contain ancient archaeological sites and hot springs. The capture of Atahualpa here became a decisive episode in the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire.
simp_chinese: 卡夏马尔卡即卡哈马卡，位于秘鲁北部高地的马什孔河谷，海拔约2750米。肥沃的周边地区分布着古代遗址和温泉。阿塔瓦尔帕在此被俘，成为西班牙征服印加帝国的决定性事件之一。

english: Kaxarari takes its name from a people whose language is spoken around the northwestern border of what is now Rondônia in Brazil. Their speech belongs to the Panoan family, yet is particularly distinct within its Mainline branch. Recorded Kaxarari vocabulary preserves separate terms for a great river and a small stream, alongside words for manioc, maize, Brazil nuts, arrows and fishhooks. This linguistic inheritance offers a close view of the waterways, plants and objects through which the region's inhabitants described their world.
simp_chinese: 卡夏拉里得名于当地族群，其语言分布在今巴西朗多尼亚州西北边界一带。卡夏拉里语属于帕诺语系，在其主体支系内部又显得格外独特。已记录的词汇对大河与小溪分别命名，也包含木薯、玉米、巴西坚果、箭和鱼钩等词。这份语言遗产，使人得以从水道、植物与器物的名称中，窥见当地居民认识周围世界的方式。

english: The Kaxixó live around Martinho Campos and Pompéu in Brazil’s Minas Gerais. Dispersed around a central village, they gained government recognition in 2001 after a long struggle opposed by some local landholders.
simp_chinese: 卡希绍人生活在巴西米纳斯吉拉斯的马蒂纽坎普斯与蓬佩乌一带。族群围绕中心村落分散居住，在受到部分当地地主反对的长期争取后，于2001年取得政府承认。

english: The waters off northern Australia belong to a tropical coastal region shaped by summer monsoons. The Great Barrier Reef forms a prominent part of the region's northeastern marine landscape.
simp_chinese: 澳大利亚北部近海属于受夏季季风影响的热带海岸区域。大堡礁是这一地区东北部海洋景观的重要组成部分。

english: Kaya belongs to Bitchū, the province on the Inland Sea side of western Honshu. Bitchū emerged in the late seventh century when old Kibi was divided. Its ancient provincial center stood near Sōja, and Kibitsu Shrine was its principal Shinto sanctuary.
simp_chinese: 贺阳属于本州西部面向濑户内海的备中。七世纪晚期，古吉备国分割后形成备中。古代国府位于总社附近，吉备津神社是境内首要神道圣地。

english: The Sumatran coast forms the edge of a long island running northwest to southeast. Offshore island chains face the Indian Ocean on its western side, while narrow straits link the island to neighbouring lands.
simp_chinese: 苏门答腊海岸构成一座西北—东南向长岛的边缘。西侧离岸岛链面向印度洋，狭窄海峡则将主岛同邻近陆地联系起来。

english: Kaya Paha belongs to the wider Wyoming landscape. The western part of this region is dominated by Rocky Mountain ranges, while high-elevation prairie extends across the east.
simp_chinese: 卡亚帕哈属于广义的怀俄明地区。该地区西部以落基山脉的山地为主，东部则延伸着高海拔草原。

english: Kayabe belongs to the northern island country historically called Ezo. That wider Japanese term referred chiefly to Hokkaido and sometimes Sakhalin and the Kurils, lands associated with the ancestors of today’s Ainu people.
simp_chinese: 茅部属于历史上称虾夷地的北方岛屿地域。这一日语名称主要指北海道，有时也包括库页岛与千岛群岛，与今日阿伊努人的祖先相关。

english: The Kayabi, also known as Kawaiwete, are an Indigenous people of northern Mato Grosso whose language belongs to the Tupi-Guarani family. Their homeland included the Teles Pires and Peixes river regions, before migrations to the Xingu reserve began in the twentieth century under pressure from commercial encroachment. Village life combines fishing and hunting with a varied agriculture. Separate plots cultivate numerous kinds of manioc, while mixed fields support maize, cotton, peanuts and other crops. Cotton grown in these fields supplies women making hammocks and carrying slings; men weave baskets and sieves. Land also binds the living to the dead: the presence of ancestral graves has been a powerful reason for some families to remain in their old homeland despite displacement elsewhere.
simp_chinese: 卡亚比人也称卡瓦伊韦特人，是马托格罗索北部的原住民族，语言属于图皮—瓜拉尼语族。他们的故土包括特莱斯皮雷斯河与佩谢斯河地区，直到二十世纪在商业开发侵入的压力下，才开始迁往欣古保留地。村落生活将捕鱼、狩猎与多样的农业结合起来。专门的田地种植许多木薯品种，混作地则栽培玉米、棉花、花生等作物。妇女用自家田里的棉花制作吊床和背带，男子编织篮筐与筛子。土地也将生者与逝者联结起来：祖坟的存在，是一些家庭在其他族人流离迁徙时仍留守故土的重要缘由。

english: These forests belong to the traditional country of the Kayabí, or Kawaiwete, in northern Mato Grosso. Many Kayabí communities later moved into the Xingu Indigenous Park and the Apiaká-Kayabi reserve while preserving their cultural traditions.
simp_chinese: 这片森林属于马托格罗索北部卡亚比人、亦称卡瓦伊韦特人的传统故土。许多卡亚比社群后来迁入欣古原住民公园及阿皮亚卡—卡亚比保护地，并延续自身文化传统。

english: Kayagar is a Papuan language of southern New Guinea. Its varieties are associated with villages in the Mappi and Asmat country, including Wiyagar-speaking settlements around Assue and Kaigar at Amagais.
simp_chinese: 卡亚加尔语是新几内亚南部的一种巴布亚语言。其不同变体与马皮和阿斯马特地区的村落相联系，包括阿苏埃一带使用Wiyagar的聚落及阿马盖斯的Kaigar。

english: Kayal belongs to Pandya Nadu in southern Tamil country. The wider region was the historic seat of the Pandya dynasty, with Madurai as its political capital and Korkai as an important early port.
simp_chinese: 迦耶尔属于泰米尔南部的潘迪亚地区。该地区是潘迪亚王朝的历史中心，马杜赖为政治首府，科尔凯则是早期重要港口。

english: Kayalyk belongs to Jetisu, the Seven Rivers region of Central Asia. The wider region takes its name from rivers flowing from the southeast into Lake Balkhash and contrasts with the drier steppes farther east.
simp_chinese: 开阿利克属于中亚的七河地区。更广阔的地区因从东南方向汇入巴尔喀什湖的河流而得名，与更东方较干燥的草原形成对照。

english: Kayambi belongs to the northern Andean world surrounding Quito. The wider region preserves the legacy of the Quitu, whose settlements occupied mountain valleys and whose plateau burial centres contained textiles, shells and metalwork. Inca expansion and the Spanish conquest of 1534 transformed this highland country.
simp_chinese: 卡扬比属于基多周围的安第斯北部地域。广阔地区保留着基图人的遗产，他们的聚落分布于山谷，高原墓葬中心中出土了织物、贝壳与金属器。印加扩张和1534年的西班牙征服改变了这片高地。

english: Kayan belongs to northern Kalimantan, a Bornean region associated with the Bulungan Sultanate. Its ruling tradition traced the princely line to a coastal Kayan princess, Asung Luwan, and a visiting Bruneian nobleman.
simp_chinese: 卡扬属于与布隆岸苏丹国相关的婆罗洲北加里曼丹地区。其统治传统把王室世系追溯到沿海卡扬公主阿松鲁万与一位来访的文莱贵族。

english: Kayan belongs to the Melawi river country of western Borneo. The Melawi meets the Kapuas at Sintang, with Ot Danum spoken upstream and Malay varieties common farther downriver.
simp_chinese: 客燕属于婆罗洲西部的美拉威河地区。美拉威河在新当汇入卡普阿斯河，上游使用奥特达努姆语，较下游则常见马来语变体。

english: Kayangel is a coral atoll north of Palau’s principal islands. Its waters lie in the western Caroline archipelago of Micronesia.
simp_chinese: 卡扬埃尔是帕劳主要岛屿以北的珊瑚环礁。周围水域位于密克罗尼西亚的西加罗林群岛。

english: Kayapo communities belong to the wider Mebêngôkre world of Indigenous Brazil. Their homelands extend through the Xingu basin and neighbouring interior, and cultivated tubers form an important part of their food traditions.
simp_chinese: 卡亚波社群属于巴西原住民中更广泛的梅本戈克雷族群。他们的故土延伸于欣古河流域及周边内陆，种植块茎作物是其饮食传统的重要部分。

english: Kayattar belongs to Pandya Nadu, the southern Tamil country whose historic political centre was Madurai. The wider region formed the principal homeland of the Pandya dynasty, while Korkai served as an important early port.
simp_chinese: 卡亚塔尔属于泰米尔南部的潘地亚地区，其历史政治中心为马杜赖。更广阔的地区是潘地亚王朝的主要故土，科尔凯则曾是重要的早期港口。

english: Kayeli belongs to Buru in the Moluccas. Buru lies between the Banda and Seram seas, and its indigenous communities include the Kayeli alongside the Buru, Lisela and other peoples.
simp_chinese: 卡耶利属于摩鹿加群岛的布鲁岛。布鲁岛位于班达海与塞兰海之间，原住民群体包括卡耶利人、布鲁人、利塞拉人等。

english: Kayen belongs to the wider Tashir country of northern Armenia, historically a canton of Gugark. The region became a centre of Armenian scholarship under the Zakarid princes before their domains fell under Mongol overlordship following the capture of Ani in 1236.
simp_chinese: 卡延处于亚美尼亚北部塔希尔地区，历史上这里是古加尔克的一县。扎卡里德诸王公统治时期，这一地区成为亚美尼亚学术文化的中心；1236年阿尼陷落后，其领地转入蒙古宗主权之下。

english: The Senegal River runs through Kayes, in a region formerly associated with the Soninke states of Diarra and Gajaaga. Across the river stood the important trading centre of Goundiourou, known to Arabic writers as Ghiyaru and later rebuilt south of the present city. Kayes itself developed only in the second half of the nineteenth century, when the Khasso prince Guéssé Sidy established a base guarding the western approaches to Medina. French troops chose the village for a fort in 1881 because Medina was difficult to reach by boat. Its later growth into a colonial and railway centre should not obscure the older trading landscape around it.
simp_chinese: 塞内加尔河流经卡耶斯，这片地区在历史上与索宁克人的迪亚拉和加贾加诸国相联系。河对岸曾有重要商埠贡迪乌鲁，阿拉伯作者称之为吉亚鲁；它后来在今城以南重建。卡耶斯本身直到19世纪后半叶才发展起来，卡索王子盖塞·西迪在此设立据点，守卫通往梅迪纳的西面道路。由于船只难以抵达梅迪纳，法军于1881年选中这座村落修筑堡垒。此后殖民据点与铁路枢纽的发展，也不应掩盖周围更古老的商贸地理。

english: Kayeskikan belongs to the country around Chequamegon Bay, an inlet of Lake Superior in northern Wisconsin. In the seventeenth century, the wider bay became a refuge for Petun, Huron and Ottawa communities fleeing the Beaver Wars.
simp_chinese: 卡耶斯基坎属于威斯康星北部苏必利尔湖支湾切夸梅根湾周边地区。十七世纪，整个海湾地区成为逃避海狸战争的佩通、休伦与渥太华社群的避难地。

english: Kayigyalik Lake belongs to the western Alaskan country of the Yupik peoples. The wider Yupik world includes the Yukon-Kuskokwim delta and the northern shores of Bristol Bay, part of a network of related Arctic peoples spanning both sides of the Bering Sea.
simp_chinese: 卡伊吉亚利克湖属于阿拉斯加西部尤皮克人的地域。更广阔的尤皮克世界包括育空—库斯科奎姆三角洲与布里斯托尔湾北岸，是跨越白令海两岸的北极民族联系网络的一部分。

english: Kaymaz lies on the route between Eskişehir and Ankara near Sivrihisar. The settlement was known as Troknada in the Phrygian period and later Kaytrus, while ruins around the town recall its long history.
simp_chinese: 卡伊马兹位于锡夫里希萨尔附近、埃斯基谢希尔通往安卡拉的道路上。聚落在弗里吉亚时期称特罗克纳达，后来称凯特鲁斯，城镇周围的遗迹也反映着悠久历史。

english: Kaynar lies in the broad steppe country known as Dasht-i Qipchaq. The name means the Steppe of the Kipchaks, while Latin writers called the Cuman–Kipchak confederation’s lands Cumania.
simp_chinese: 凯纳尔位于广称钦察草原的地区。这个名称意为钦察人的草原，拉丁文作者则把库曼—钦察部落联盟的土地称作库曼尼亚。

english: Kaynar belongs to the wider Kulunda plain between the Ob and Irtysh. This alluvial steppe extends across parts of Russia and Kazakhstan. The Kuchuk, Kulunda and Burla drain the region, while large lakes occupy its central lowlands.
simp_chinese: 凯纳尔属于鄂毕河与额尔齐斯河之间广阔的库伦达平原。这片冲积草原延伸于俄罗斯和哈萨克斯坦部分地区。库丘克河、库伦达河和布尔拉河流经区域，大型湖泊则占据中部低地。

english: Kaypikupau belongs to Nunavik, the Inuit homeland in northern Quebec. The regional name means “great land” in the local Inuktitut dialect, and Nunavik forms part of the broader Inuit Nunangat.
simp_chinese: 凯皮库保属于魁北克北部的因纽特人故土努纳维克。该地区名称在当地因纽特语方言中意为“大地”，努纳维克也是广义因纽特努纳加特的一部分。

english: Kayrakty is a small settlement in Kazakhstan’s Aktobe region. It bore the name Borodinovka until 2007. The village lies at an elevation of about three hundred and forty metres in the Kargaly district.
simp_chinese: 凯拉克特是哈萨克斯坦阿克托别地区的一处小聚落。直到2007年，这里仍称博罗季诺夫卡。村落位于卡尔加雷区，海拔约三百四十米。

english: Kaysun, now Çakırhüyük, stood on the route between Marash and Samosata, in a borderland repeatedly contested by Arab, Byzantine, Armenian and Frankish powers. In the late eleventh century it became the centre of the Armenian lord Kogh Vasil, who restored its defences and patronised the church. Catholicoi and scholars found refuge here; the nearby Red Monastery helped sustain Armenian religious learning. The chronicler Matthew of Edessa also settled in the town. Earthquake and war repeatedly interrupted this cultural life. Kaysun's history joins the vulnerability of a fortified frontier settlement to its role as a place where displaced religious institutions could take root again.
simp_chinese: 凯孙，即今日的查克尔许于克，位于马拉什与萨莫萨塔之间的道路上，所在边境屡遭阿拉伯、拜占庭、亚美尼亚和法兰克势力争夺。十一世纪后期，这里成为亚美尼亚领主科格·瓦西尔的统治中心，他修复防御设施并资助教会。教会领袖和学者在此寻得庇护，附近的红修道院也维系着亚美尼亚宗教学术。编年史家埃德萨的马修同样曾定居城中。地震和战争反复打断这种文化生活。凯孙的历史将边境堡城的脆弱处境，与流离宗教机构在此重新扎根的作用联系在一起。

english: Kayuadi belongs to the Selayar Islands off southern Sulawesi. Most inhabitants speak Selayar, and agriculture includes cassava and bananas. Sea-cucumber gathering has also provided a livelihood, while the island shelters a small form of the reticulated python.
simp_chinese: 卡尤阿迪岛属于苏拉威西南部近海的塞拉亚群岛。大部分居民使用塞拉亚语，农业种植木薯和香蕉，采集海参也是生计来源。岛上还生活着一种体型较小的网纹蟒。

english: Kazachinskoye is a rural settlement in the Krasnoyarsk country of Siberia. In modern administration it belongs to the Kazachinsky district and village council of the same name.
simp_chinese: 卡扎钦斯科耶是西伯利亚克拉斯诺亚尔斯克地区的一处乡村聚落。现代行政上，它属于同名的卡扎钦区及村级行政区。

english: Kazachye is a rural settlement in the Sakha Republic’s Bulunsky District. It serves as the centre of Kazachinsky National Rural Okrug, roughly 486 kilometres from the district centre of Tiksi.
simp_chinese: 卡扎奇耶是萨哈共和国布伦区的一处乡村聚落。这里是卡扎奇民族乡的中心，距区治季克西约四百八十六公里。

english: Kazaidi belongs to the eastern Lunda world around Katanga. The wider Lunda commonwealth linked states across modern Congo, northeastern Angola and northwestern Zambia. Its traditions recall ties with Luba rulers and the creation of the paramount title Mwane-a-Yamvu.
simp_chinese: 卡扎伊迪属于加丹加周边东部隆达世界。广大隆达共同体连接今刚果、安哥拉东北部与赞比亚西北部诸国。其传统记载了与卢巴统治者的联系及最高称号姆瓦内亚扬武的创立。

english:
At the meeting of the Kazanka and the Volga, Kazan grew from a Bulgar frontier settlement into the capital of a khanate. In 1438 Ulugh Muhammad made it the seat of the Khanate of Kazan. Its Taş Ayaq bazaar drew regional trade, while craftsmen acquired a reputation for leatherwork and gold objects; commercial connections reached Moscow, Crimea and the Ottoman lands.

Ivan IV captured Kazan after the siege of 1552. The conquest destroyed palaces and mosques and displaced much of the Tatar population, while a Tatar settlement outside the walls later gathered merchants and artisans. Fire and rebellion repeatedly reshaped the city. After the devastation of Pugachev's rising in 1774, rebuilding under Catherine II introduced more stone construction and a regular street plan, and permission to build mosques again helped renew its Muslim religious life.
simp_chinese:
喀山位于喀山河与伏尔加河交汇处，由保加尔人的边境聚落发展为汗国都城。1438年，兀鲁·穆罕默德将这里定为喀山汗国的统治中心。塔什阿亚克集市汇聚区域贸易，工匠以皮革和金器闻名，商路通往莫斯科、克里米亚与奥斯曼诸地。

1552年，伊凡四世围城后攻陷喀山。征服摧毁了宫殿与清真寺，并迫使许多鞑靼居民迁离；城墙外的鞑靼聚居区后来又汇集商人与工匠。大火与叛乱屡次改变城市面貌。1774年普加乔夫起义造成严重破坏后，叶卡捷琳娜二世治下的重建增加了石造建筑，并采用规整街道布局；重新准许兴建清真寺，也推动了当地穆斯林宗教生活的恢复。

english: The Kazan uplands belong to the broad northern country historically known as Keewatin. The name means north wind in Cree and Ojibwe, reflecting an Indigenous geographical vocabulary later adopted by Canadian administration.
simp_chinese: 卡赞高地属于历史上称为基韦廷的广阔北方地域。该名称在克里语与奥吉布瓦语中意为北风，体现了后来被加拿大行政区划采用的原住民地理词汇。

english: Kazari lies in the Oka river country of Ryazan. The old regional capital was destroyed during the Mongol invasion of 1237, after which the princely seat moved to Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky.
simp_chinese: 卡扎里位于梁赞的奥卡河地区。旧地区都城在1237年的蒙古入侵中被毁，此后王公治所迁往佩列亚斯拉夫尔—梁赞斯基。

english: Kazatlyk lies within the broader Central Asian world of Transoxiana. This historical region stretches between the Amu Darya and Syr Darya, and its classical history includes Persian Sogdia and the conquests of Alexander.
simp_chinese: 卡扎特雷克处于中亚河中地区的广阔历史背景之中。这一地区横跨阿姆河与锡尔河之间，其古代历史包括波斯治下的粟特及亚历山大的征服。

english: Kazaure occupies a valley enclosed by imposing plateaus in northern Hausaland. Oral tradition traces its beginnings to Hausa hunters led by Kutumbi around 1300, and explains its name through an exclamation likening the sheltered valley to an inner room. The emirate belongs to a much later age: Dan Tunku, a standard-bearer of Usman dan Fodio's jihad, established his headquarters here in 1819. His refusal to acknowledge Kano's authority led to years of fighting, including a Kano occupation of his fortified camp followed by a successful counterattack in 1824. Sultan Bello's arbitration ultimately recognized Kazaure as a separate emirate and settled its boundaries.
simp_chinese: 卡扎乌雷坐落在豪萨北部一处为高大台地环抱的河谷中。口述传统将其起源追溯至约1300年由库通比带领的豪萨猎人，并把地名解释为一句感叹：这处受到山地庇护的谷地仿佛一间内室。埃米尔国则形成于晚得多的时代：乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥圣战的旗手丹·通库于1819年在此建立统治中心。他拒绝承认卡诺的权威，导致双方连年交战；1824年卡诺军队一度攻占他的设防营地，随后又被其反击逐出。苏丹贝洛最终仲裁，承认卡扎乌雷为独立埃米尔国，并划定边界。

english: Kazeh lay in Unyanyembe, amid the Nyamwezi villages of the East African interior. Coastal traders began settling in the region in the early 1830s to participate in the ivory and slave caravan trade; the settlement known as Kazeh near present-day Tabora was established by Swahili and Omani traders in the 1850s. Its later prominence therefore belongs to the nineteenth century. Nyamwezi communities supplied food and caravan labour, while merchants maintained links reaching north to Buganda. By 1870, large courtyard houses combined living quarters, gardens and storerooms, giving this inland trading centre a distinctive urban form.
simp_chinese: 卡泽位于东非内陆的乌尼扬延贝，周围分布着尼亚姆韦齐人的村落。十九世纪三十年代初，沿海商人开始在这一带定居，参与象牙与奴隶的商队贸易；现今塔波拉附近名为卡泽的聚落，则由斯瓦希里和阿曼商人在十九世纪五十年代建立。因此，它后来作为贸易重镇的兴起属于十九世纪的历史。尼亚姆韦齐各社区提供粮食和商队劳力，商人的联系则向北远达布干达。到1870年，当地的大型庭院住宅将居所、园地与仓房结合在一起，形成了这座内陆商埠独特的城镇景观。

english: The Luapula valley and Lake Mweru supplied the fisheries, farmland and woodland resources upon which the Kazembe kingdom rose in the eighteenth century. Around 1740, a party from the Luba-Lunda realm moved eastward; under Kanyembo Mpemba it crossed the Luapula at Matanda, subdued the Shila and installed a new chiefly aristocracy. The newcomers preserved Luba-Lunda court traditions while adopting the Bemba language. Copper from Katanga and the lake fisheries supported a power that attracted Portuguese envoys seeking a route between Angola and Mozambique. Expeditions in 1798 and 1831 left descriptions of its elaborate court, but failed to secure the trading alliance their sponsors desired.
simp_chinese: 卢阿普拉河谷与姆韦鲁湖提供的渔产、农田和林地资源，是十八世纪卡曾贝王国崛起的基础。约1740年，一支队伍从卢巴—隆达王国东迁；在卡涅姆博·姆彭巴率领下，他们于马坦达渡过卢阿普拉河，征服希拉人，并建立新的酋长贵族阶层。迁入者保留了卢巴—隆达的宫廷传统，同时采用本巴语。加丹加的铜矿和湖区渔业支撑了这一政权，也吸引了试图打通安哥拉至莫桑比克路线的葡萄牙使节。1798年与1831年的远征留下了关于其隆重宫廷仪式的记述，却未能取得资助者期待的贸易同盟。

english: Kazerun lies in northwestern Fars in Iran. Nearby Bishapur had been a Sasanian imperial centre before the rise of Kazerun as the region’s principal settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡泽伦位于伊朗法尔斯西北部。在卡泽伦成为这一地区的主要聚落之前，附近的比沙普尔曾是萨珊帝国的重要中心。

english: Kazhi belongs to the Litang country of Kham. In this wider eastern Tibetan region, warrior principalities and Buddhist monasteries shared a rugged landscape of forest, grassland and deep valleys. Litang was among the territories attacked during Gompo Namgyal’s nineteenth-century expansion.
simp_chinese: 卡孜属于康区的理塘地域。在这片广阔的藏东地区，武士邦国与佛教寺院共同分布于森林、草地和深谷交织的崎岖地貌中。十九世纪贡布南杰扩张时，理塘也是其进攻目标之一。

english: Kazhma belongs to the broader Baykit country of central Siberia. Baykit itself stands on the Podkamennaya Tunguska River in the Evenki district of Krasnoyarsk, where a subarctic climate shapes the regional setting.
simp_chinese: 卡日马属于西伯利亚中部更广阔的拜基特地区。拜基特本身坐落在克拉斯诺亚尔斯克鄂温克地区的石泉通古斯河畔，区域环境受到亚寒带气候塑造。

english: Kazimah belongs to the northern Gulf country around Wadi al-Batin. This intermittent watercourse is the lower section of Wadi al-Rummah and crosses the Al-Dibdibah gravel plain toward Kuwait and Iraq.
simp_chinese: 卡济马属于巴廷干河周围的海湾北部地区。这条间歇性水道是鲁马干河的下段，穿过迪卜迪拜砾石平原，通向科威特与伊拉克。

english: Kazimierz belongs to the Lublin country of historical Lesser Poland. Lublin flourished on the route between Vilnius and Krakow, benefiting from privileges of free trade in Lithuania.
simp_chinese: 卡齐米日属于历史上小波兰的卢布林地区。卢布林在维尔纽斯与克拉科夫之间的商路上繁荣，受惠于在立陶宛自由贸易的特权。

english: Kazungala belongs to the broader Maligo cultural region of southern Angola. Maligo is a name associated with a variety of Sekele, the northern part of the !Kung dialect continuum, whose related speech communities extend southward into northern Namibia.
simp_chinese: 卡尊加拉属于安哥拉南部广阔的马利戈文化地域。马利戈是塞凯莱语一种变体的名称，后者属于昆语方言连续体北部，其相关语言社群向南延伸至纳米比亚北部。

english: Kazuno occupies the Hanawa Basin in the upper country of the Yoneshiro River, with forested mountains rising toward the Ōu range to the east. Rivers, waterfalls and hot springs break up this rugged landscape, where inland winters bring heavy snow. Human settlement reaches far beyond the age of the samurai: the Ōyu stone circles belong to the Jōmon period, and burial mounds preserve traces of later prehistoric communities. Historically part of Mutsu, the district came under the Nambu clan of Morioka during the Edo period. Agriculture and woodland resources sustained its settlements, with rice grown even in this mountainous country. The present city was formed only in 1972 by combining Hanawa, Towada, Osarizawa and Hachimantai; its modern boundaries gather together several older communities rather than marking a single medieval town.
simp_chinese: 鹿角位于米代川流域的花轮盆地，东面林木覆盖的山地逐渐升向奥羽山脉。河流、瀑布和温泉散布在崎岖地形之间，内陆冬季常有厚雪。这里的人类定居远早于武士时代：大汤环状列石属于绳文时期，古坟也留下了后来史前社群的痕迹。鹿角历史上属于陆奥，江户时代由盛冈藩南部氏统治。农业与森林资源支撑着各处聚落，即使山地之间也有水稻种植。今日的鹿角市直到1972年才由花轮、十和田、尾去泽和八幡平合并成立；现代市界汇集了数个古老社区，并不代表一座统一的中世纪城市。

english: The Kazym rises in the Siberian Uvaly and winds through a marshy valley to the Ob. Fed mainly by snow, the river freezes in early November and usually begins to thaw only in late May.
simp_chinese: 卡济姆河发源于西伯利亚丘陵，蜿蜒穿过沼泽河谷流向鄂毕河。河水主要来自融雪，11月初封冻，通常要到翌年5月底才开始解冻。

english: Kcewite belongs to the Kawésqar world of Chilean Patagonia. The wider indigenous homeland includes islands and peninsulas around the channels northwest of the Strait of Magellan, and the Kawésqar language’s name means person or human being.
simp_chinese: 克塞维特属于智利巴塔哥尼亚的卡韦斯卡尔人世界。更广阔的原住民故土包括麦哲伦海峡西北部水道周边的岛屿与半岛，卡韦斯卡尔语之名意为人或人类。

english: Kcheeminpink belongs to the country now called New Brunswick. The wider region overlaps the homelands of the Mi’kmaq, Wolastoqiyik and Passamaquoddy and later became a principal part of Acadia.
simp_chinese: 克奇明平克属于如今称为新不伦瑞克的地区。这片广大地域覆盖米克马克、沃拉斯托基伊克与帕萨马科迪等族的故土，后来成为阿卡迪亚的重要部分。

english: Off Keahole Point, the sea meets the westernmost shore of the island of Hawaii. The headland takes its name from the ahole fish found in nearby waters, and its coast belongs to the old community of Kalaoa. A surviving house platform, enclosure and deposits of marine shells and volcanic glass reveal domestic life here between about 1500 and 1800. The shoreline itself is younger in places than those households: in 1801, lava from Hualalai's Huehue flow pushed the coast outward by about a mile and added several square kilometres of land. Fishing grounds, household remains and new lava stand close together along this changing edge of the island.
